title.zh: 卷八 本紀第八: 玄宗上
title.raw: 卷八 本紀第八: 玄宗上 Volume 8 Annals 8: Xuanzong 1

sentences.zh: 玄宗至道大聖大明孝皇帝諱隆基，睿宗第三子也，母曰昭成順聖皇后竇氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong, posthumous title To-the-Way Great Sage Great Illustrious Filial, bore the taboo name Longji, third son of Ruizong; his mother was Empress Zhaocheng the Shunsheng, née Dou.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong — Emperor Xuanzong, styled To-the-Way Great Sage Great Illustrious Filial, bore the taboo name Longji. He was Ruizong's third son; his mother was Empress Zhaocheng the Shunsheng of the Dou clan.

sentences.zh: 垂拱元年秋八月戊寅，生於東都。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn of Chuigong 1, on wuyin, he was born in the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Chuigong 1, on wuyin, he was born at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 性英斷多藝，尤知音律，善八分書。

translations.literal: By nature he was decisive and gifted in many arts, especially skilled in music, and adept at clerical script.
translations.idiomatic: He was decisive and multitalented, especially in music, and wrote a fine clerical hand.

sentences.zh: 儀範偉麗，有非常之表。

translations.literal: His bearing was grand and imposing, with an extraordinary presence.
translations.idiomatic: His bearing was grand and imposing, with a presence beyond the ordinary.

sentences.zh: 三年閏七月丁卯，封楚王。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month of the third year, on dingmao, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month of that year, on dingmao, he was made Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 天授三年十月戊戌，出閣，開府置官屬，年始七歲。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of Tianshou 3, on wuxu, he left the inner quarters, opened a princely establishment with staff—he was only seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Tianshou 3, on wuxu, he left the inner palace, opened a princely household with officials, and was only seven years old.

sentences.zh: 朔望車騎至朝堂，金吾將軍武懿宗忌上嚴整，訶排儀仗，因欲折之。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of each month his carriage and escort came to the audience hall; Golden Guard general Wu Yizong resented the prince's strict order, berated and drove off his guard of honor, intending to humiliate him.
translations.idiomatic: On new and full moons his escort came to court; Wu Yizong of the golden guard, resenting the prince's discipline, shouted down his guard and tried to break his pride.

sentences.zh: 上叱之曰：「吾家朝堂，干汝何事？

translations.literal: The prince rebuked him, saying: "This is my family's court—what business is it of yours?
translations.idiomatic: The prince shouted back: "This is our house's court—what is it to you?

sentences.zh: 敢迫吾騎從！

translations.literal: How dare you press upon my escort!"
translations.idiomatic: How dare you harass my retinue!"

sentences.zh: 」則天聞而特加寵異之。

translations.literal: When Zetian heard of it she showed him special favor.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian heard of it and singled him out for special favor.

sentences.zh: 尋卻入閣。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he returned to the inner quarters.
translations.idiomatic: He soon returned to the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 長壽二年臘月丁卯，改封臨淄郡王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of Changshou 2, on dingmao, his title was changed to Prince of Linzi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Changshou 2, on dingmao, he was made Prince of Linzi commandery.

sentences.zh: 聖歷元年，出閣，賜第於東都積善坊。

translations.literal: In Shenglì 1 he left the inner quarters and was granted a residence in Jishan ward of the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Shenglì 1 he left the inner palace and was given a mansion in Luoyang's Jishan ward.

sentences.zh: 大足元年，從幸西京，賜宅於興慶坊。

translations.literal: In Dazu 1 he accompanied the court to the western capital and was granted a residence in Xingqing ward.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazu 1 he followed the court to Chang'an and received a mansion in Xingqing ward.

sentences.zh: 長安中，歷右衛郎將、尚輦奉御。

translations.literal: In the Chang'an era he served as right guard lieutenant and director of the imperial equipage.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chang'an years he was right guard lieutenant and director of the imperial equipage.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年，遷衛尉少卿。

translations.literal: In Shenlong 1 he was promoted to vice minister of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Shenlong 1 he became vice minister of the guard.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年四月，兼潞州別駕。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Jinglong 2 he was made concurrent acting prefect of Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Jinglong 2 he became acting prefect of Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月，加銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was given the silver-blue-glow grandee rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he received the silver-blue-glow grandee rank.

sentences.zh: 州境有黃龍白日升天。

translations.literal: Within the prefecture a yellow dragon and white sun were seen ascending to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the prefecture a yellow dragon and a white sun were seen rising into the sky.

sentences.zh: 嘗出畋，有紫雲在其上，後從者望而得之。

translations.literal: Once when he went hunting, purple clouds hung above him; those following behind looked up and saw them.
translations.idiomatic: Once on a hunt purple clouds hung over him, and those riding behind looked up and saw them.

sentences.zh: 前後符瑞凡一十九事。

translations.literal: Such omens and portents numbered nineteen in all.
translations.idiomatic: Such omens and portents totaled nineteen.

sentences.zh: 四年，中宗將祀南郊，來朝京師。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he came to the capital because Zhongzong was about to sacrifice at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he came to the capital as Zhongzong prepared to sacrifice at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 將行，使術士韓禮筮之，蓍一莖孑然獨立。

translations.literal: Before he departed, he had the diviner Han Li cast the yarrow stalks; one stalk stood alone.
translations.idiomatic: Before leaving he had the diviner Han Li cast the yarrow; a single stalk stood upright.

sentences.zh: 禮驚曰：「蓍立，奇瑞非常也，不可言。

translations.literal: Li was startled and said: "A stalk standing alone—an omen beyond the ordinary; it cannot be spoken."
translations.idiomatic: Li cried out in wonder: "A lone upright stalk—an omen beyond words; do not speak of it."

sentences.zh: 」屬中宗末年，王室多故，上常陰引材力之士以自助。

translations.literal: In Zhongzong's last years the imperial house was in turmoil, and the prince often secretly gathered men of ability to aid himself.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongzong's last years the house was in turmoil, and the prince quietly gathered able men to strengthen his hand.

sentences.zh: 上所居宅外有水池，浸溢頃餘，望氣者以為龍氣。

translations.literal: Outside his residence was a pool that overflowed for some time; those who read the qi called it dragon vapor.
translations.idiomatic: A pool outside his mansion overflowed for some time; geomancers called it dragon vapor.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，中宗幸其第，因游其池，結彩為樓船，令巨象踏之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year Zhongzong visited his residence and toured the pool; colored silks were tied into tower-ships, and great elephants were made to tread them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Zhongzong visited his mansion and toured the pool, where silken tower-ships were rigged for great elephants to tread.

sentences.zh: 至六月，中宗暴崩，韋后臨朝稱制。

translations.literal: By the sixth month Zhongzong died suddenly and Empress Wei ruled as regent.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth month Zhongzong died suddenly and Empress Wei seized the regency.

sentences.zh: 韋溫、宗楚客、紀處訥等謀傾宗社，以睿宗介弟之重，先謀不利。

translations.literal: Wei Wen, Zong Chuke, Ji Chuna, and others plotted to overturn the dynasty; because of Ruizong's weight as the emperor's younger brother, they first plotted against him.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Wen, Zong Chuke, Ji Chuna, and others plotted to overturn the throne; fearing Ruizong's standing as the emperor's brother, they moved against him first.

sentences.zh: 道士馮道力、處士劉承祖皆善於占兆，詣上布誠款。

translations.literal: The Daoist Feng Daoli and the recluse Liu Chengzu were both skilled at divination; they came to the prince and pledged their loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoist Feng Daoli and the recluse Liu Chengzu, both skilled diviners, came to the prince and pledged themselves.

sentences.zh: 上所居里名隆慶，時人語訛以「隆」為「龍」；

translations.literal: The ward where he lived was called Longqing; people slurred the name and said "dragon";
translations.idiomatic: His ward was called Longqing; people punned the name into "dragon";

sentences.zh: 韋庶人稱制，改元又為唐隆，皆符御名。

translations.literal: when Empress Wei took power the era name was changed to Tanglong—all matched his name and title.
translations.idiomatic: when Empress Wei ruled she renamed the era Tanglong—every sign matched his name.

sentences.zh: 上益自負，乃與太平公主謀之，公主喜，以子崇簡從。

translations.literal: The prince grew more confident and plotted with Princess Taiping; the princess was pleased and sent her son Chongjian to join.
translations.idiomatic: Growing bolder, he plotted with Princess Taiping; she was delighted and sent her son Chongjian to help.

sentences.zh: 上乃與崇簡、朝邑尉劉幽求、長上折沖麻嗣宗、押萬騎果毅葛福順李仙鳧、寶昌寺僧普潤等定策誅之。

translations.literal: He then settled the plan with Chongjian, Chaoyi lieutenant Liu Youqiu, senior guard officer Ma Sizong, ten-thousand-cavalry commander Ge Fushun and Li Xianfu, and the Baochang monk Puyun, among others, to execute the Wei faction.
translations.idiomatic: With Chongjian, Liu Youqiu, Ma Sizong, Ge Fushun, Li Xianfu, the monk Puyun, and others he fixed a plan to kill the Wei faction.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「先啟大王。

translations.literal: Some said: "First inform the Prince of Xiang."
translations.idiomatic: Some urged: "Ask the Prince of Xiang first."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「我拯社稷之危，赴君父之急，事成福歸於宗社，不成身死於忠孝，安可先請，憂怖大王乎！

translations.literal: The prince said: "I am saving the altars from peril and rushing to my father's crisis—if we succeed, the blessing returns to the state; if we fail, I die in loyalty. How can I ask first and frighten the king?
translations.idiomatic: The prince said: "I am saving the realm and rushing to my father's peril—success blesses the altars, failure is death in loyalty. How can I ask first and terrify the king?

sentences.zh: 若請而從，是王與危事；

translations.literal: If he consents, he is bound to a dangerous affair;
translations.idiomatic: If he agrees, he is drawn into danger;

sentences.zh: 請而不從，則吾計失矣。

translations.literal: if he refuses, our plan is lost."
translations.idiomatic: if he refuses, our plan is ruined."

sentences.zh: 」遂以庚子夜率幽求等數十人自苑南入，總監鐘紹京又率丁匠百餘以從。

translations.literal: That night, on gengzi, he led Youqiu and several dozen men in from the south of the park; Director of Works Zhong Shaojing also led more than a hundred artisans to follow.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi night he led Youqiu and dozens of men in from the south of the park; Zhong Shaojing of the works directorate brought more than a hundred craftsmen.

sentences.zh: 分遣萬騎往玄武門殺羽林將軍韋播、高嵩，持首而至，眾歡叫大集。

translations.literal: He sent the ten-thousand-cavalry to the Xuanwu Gate to kill the feathered-forest generals Wei Bo and Gao Song, brought their heads back, and the host shouted and gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Ten-thousand-cavalry detachments killed feathered-forest generals Wei Bo and Gao Song at the Xuanwu Gate and returned with their heads; the host roared and rallied.

sentences.zh: 攻白獸、玄德等門，斬關而進，左萬騎自左入，右萬騎自右入，合於凌煙閣前。

translations.literal: They attacked the White Beast and Mysterious Virtue gates, cut through the barriers, and entered; the left ten-thousand-cavalry entered from the left, the right from the right, and met before the Tower of Lingyan.
translations.idiomatic: They stormed the White Beast and Mysterious Virtue gates, cut the bars, and burst in; left and right ten-thousand-cavalry columns met before the Tower of Lingyan.

sentences.zh: 時太極殿前有宿衛梓宮萬騎，聞噪聲，皆披甲應之。

translations.literal: At that time before the Hall of Supreme Ultimate stood the guard of honor for the late emperor's bier; hearing the uproar, they all donned armor and responded.
translations.idiomatic: Guards of honor for the late emperor's bier stood before the Hall of Supreme Ultimate; hearing the clamor, they armed and answered.

sentences.zh: 韋庶人惶惑走入飛騎營，為亂兵所害。

translations.literal: Empress Wei fled in panic into the flying-cavalry camp and was killed by the mutinous troops.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wei fled in panic into the flying-cavalry camp and was cut down by the mutineers.

sentences.zh: 於是分遣誅韋氏之黨，比明，內外討捕，皆斬之。

translations.literal: They then sent parties to execute the Wei faction; by dawn, inside and outside, pursuit and capture had all been beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Parties were sent to slaughter the Wei faction; by dawn every pursuer inside and out had taken heads.

sentences.zh: 乃馳謁睿宗，謝不先啟請之罪。

translations.literal: He then galloped to Ruizong and apologized for not having asked permission first.
translations.idiomatic: He galloped to Ruizong and begged pardon for not having asked leave first.

sentences.zh: 睿宗遽前抱上而泣曰：「宗社禍難，由汝安定，神祇萬姓，賴汝之力也。

translations.literal: Ruizong rushed forward, embraced the prince, and wept: "The altars' peril—you have settled it; gods and people alike rely on your strength."
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong ran to embrace him, weeping: "You have steadied the altars in calamity; gods and people rest on your strength."

sentences.zh: 」拜殿中監、同中書門下三品，兼押左右萬騎，進封平王。

translations.literal: " He was appointed director of the palace workshops, equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery, with charge of the left and right ten-thousand-cavalry, and advanced to Prince of Ping.
translations.idiomatic: He was made director of palace workshops, third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery, commander of the left and right ten-thousand-cavalry, and Prince of Ping.

sentences.zh: 睿宗即位，與侍臣議立皇太子，僉曰：「除天下之禍者，享天下之福；

translations.literal: When Ruizong took the throne he discussed installing a crown prince with his attendants; all said: "Who removes the realm's disaster enjoys the realm's blessing;
translations.idiomatic: When Ruizong ascended he asked his ministers about the crown prince; all said: "Who lifts the realm from disaster earns its blessing;

sentences.zh: 拯天下之危者，受天下之安。

translations.literal: who saves the realm from peril receives its security."
translations.idiomatic: who saves it from peril receives its peace."

sentences.zh: 平王有聖德，定天下，又聞成器已下咸有推讓，宜膺主鬯，以副群心。

translations.literal: The Prince of Ping has sagely virtue and settled the realm; we also hear that Chengqi and his younger brothers all yield—he should bear the ancestral wine and answer the people's hearts."
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ping has sagely virtue and settled the realm; Chengqi and the younger princes are said to yield—he should bear the ancestral sacrifice and satisfy every heart."

sentences.zh: 」睿宗從之。

translations.literal: " Ruizong followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，制曰：

translations.literal: On bingwu an edict was issued:
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the throne issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，睿宗御承天門，皇太子詣朝堂受冊。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the seventh month Ruizong presided at the Gate of Accepting Heaven; the crown prince went to the audience hall to receive the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the seventh month Ruizong sat at the Gate of Accepting Heaven while the crown prince received investiture in the audience hall.

sentences.zh: 是日有景雲之瑞，改元為景雲，大赦天下。

translations.literal: That day there was an auspicious cloud; the era name was changed to Jingyun, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: That day auspicious clouds appeared; the era was renamed Jingyun and the realm received a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 二年，又制曰：「惟天生丞人，牧以元後；

translations.literal: In the second year another edict said: "Heaven begets the multitude and the sovereign tends them;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year another edict read: "Heaven begets the people and the sovereign tends them;

sentences.zh: 維皇立國，副以儲君。

translations.literal: the throne establishes the state and appoints an heir to assist."
translations.idiomatic: the throne founds the state and sets an heir to assist."

sentences.zh: 將以保綏家邦，安固後嗣者也。

translations.literal: This is to secure the house and firm the succession.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the house is secured and the succession made firm.

sentences.zh: 朕纂承洪業，欽奉寶圖，夜分不寢，日昃忘倦。

translations.literal: We have inherited the great enterprise and reverently hold the imperial chart; at midnight we do not sleep, at sundown we forget weariness.
translations.idiomatic: We have inherited the great enterprise and hold the imperial chart in awe; we sleep after midnight and forget rest at sundown.

sentences.zh: 茫茫四海，懼一人之未周；

translations.literal: Across the vast seas we fear one man may not be reached;
translations.idiomatic: Across the vast seas we fear one man may go unreached;

sentences.zh: 蒸蒸萬姓，恐一物之失所。

translations.literal: among the teeming people we fear one thing may be lost.
translations.idiomatic: among the countless people we fear even one thing may be lost.

sentences.zh: 雖卿士竭誠，守宰宣化，緬懷庶域，仍未小康。

translations.literal: Though ministers exhaust their loyalty and magistrates spread their teaching, gazing over the realm we are still not at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Though ministers give all their loyalty and magistrates spread good rule, looking over the realm we are not yet at ease.

sentences.zh: 是以求下人之變風，遵先朝之故事。

translations.literal: Therefore we seek the people's changing winds and follow the former court's precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we seek the people's voice and follow precedent of the former court.

sentences.zh: 皇太子基仁孝因心，溫恭成德，深達禮體，能辨皇猷，宜令監國，俾爾為政。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Ji is filial and humane by nature, warm and reverent in virtue, deeply versed in ritual, and able to discern the imperial design—he should oversee the state and let him govern.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Ji is filial by nature, reverent in conduct, steeped in ritual, and clear in statecraft—let him oversee the realm and govern in our stead.

sentences.zh: 其六品以下除授及徒罪已下，並取基處分。

translations.literal: Appointments and dismissals from the sixth rank down and penal servitude and below shall all be decided by Ji."
translations.idiomatic: Appointments through the sixth rank and penal cases through penal servitude shall all be decided by Ji."

sentences.zh: 」先天元年延和元年六月，兇黨因術人聞睿宗曰：「據玄象，帝座及前星有災，皇太子合作天子，不合更居東宮矣。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month of Xiantian 1, the villainous faction had diviners tell Ruizong: "According to the celestial signs, the imperial seat and the fore-star suffer calamity; the crown prince ought to become Son of Heaven and should no longer dwell in the eastern palace."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Xiantian 1 plotters had diviners tell Ruizong: "The stars show calamity on the throne and the heir— the crown prince should become emperor and not remain in the eastern palace."

sentences.zh: 」睿宗曰：「傳德避災，吾意決矣。

translations.literal: " Ruizong said: "To pass virtue and avoid disaster—my mind is decided."
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong said: "To pass on virtue and flee disaster—my mind is made up."
[End of edict.]

sentences.zh: 七月壬午，制曰：

translations.literal: On renwu of the seventh month an edict was issued:
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the seventh month the throne issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 上意惶懼，馳見叩頭，請所以傳位之旨。

translations.literal: The prince was fearful; he galloped in, kowtowed, and asked the meaning of the intended abdication.
translations.idiomatic: The prince was terrified; he galloped in, kowtowed, and begged to know why the throne would abdicate.

sentences.zh: 睿宗曰：「吾因汝功業得宗社。

translations.literal: Ruizong said: "Through your merit I gained the altars."
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong said: "Through your merit I hold the altars."

sentences.zh: 今帝座有眚，思欲遜避，唯聖德大勛，始轉禍為福。

translations.literal: Now the imperial seat has a blemish; I wish to yield and withdraw—only great sagely virtue and great merit can turn calamity into blessing."
translations.idiomatic: Now the throne bears a blemish in heaven; I mean to yield—only great virtue and merit can turn calamity to blessing."

sentences.zh: 易位於汝，吾知晚矣。

translations.literal: To transfer the position to you—I know it is late."
translations.idiomatic: To place the throne in your hands—I know I am late."

sentences.zh: 」上始居武德殿視事，三品以下除授及徒罪皆自決之。

translations.literal: The prince then administered affairs from Wude Hall; appointments and dismissals from the third rank down and penal cases he decided himself.
translations.idiomatic: He then held court at Wude Hall and decided appointments through the third rank and all penal cases himself.

sentences.zh: 開元元年先天二年七月三日，尚書左僕射竇懷貞、侍中岑羲、中書令蕭至忠崔湜、雍州長史李晉、左羽林大將軍常元楷、右羽林將軍李慈等與太平公主同謀，期以其月四日以羽林軍作亂。

translations.literal: On the third day of the seventh month of Xiantian 2, inaugural Kaiyuan 1, Left Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs Dou Huaizhen, Attendant-in-Chief Cen Yi, Secretariat Director Xiao Zhibo and Cui Shi, Yongzhou chief administrator Li Jin, Left Feathered Forest grand general Chang Yuankai, Right Feathered Forest general Li Ci, and others joined Princess Taiping in a plot to raise the feathered-forest troops in revolt on the fourth of that month.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day of the seventh month of Xiantian 2—the first day of Kaiyuan—Dou Huaizhen, Cen Yi, Xiao Zhibo, Cui Shi, Li Jin, Chang Yuankai, Li Ci, and others joined Princess Taiping to plot a feathered-forest revolt for the fourth.

sentences.zh: 上密知之，因以中旨告岐王範、薛王業、兵部尚書郭元振、將軍王毛仲，取閑廄馬及家人三百餘人，率太僕少卿李令問、王守一、內侍高力士、果毅李守德等親信十數人，出武德殿，入虔化門。

translations.literal: The emperor learned of it in secret and told Princes of Qi and Xue Fan and Ye, Minister of War Guo Yuanzhen, and Generals Wang Maozhong and others; taking more than three hundred horses from the spare stables and over three hundred household retainers, he led Grand Master of the Stud Li Lingwen, Wang Shouyi, inner attendant Gao Lishi, commander Li Shoude, and a dozen trusted men out of Wude Hall and through the Qianhua Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Forewarned, he told Princes Fan and Ye, Guo Yuanzhen, and Wang Maozhong; with three hundred spare-stable horses and household troops he led Li Lingwen, Wang Shouyi, Gao Lishi, Li Shoude, and a dozen intimates out of Wude Hall through the Qianhua Gate.

sentences.zh: 梟常元楷、李慈於北闕。

translations.literal: Chang Yuankai and Li Ci were beheaded at the northern gate.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Yuankai and Li Ci lost their heads at the northern gate.

sentences.zh: 擒賈膺福、李猷於內客省以出。

translations.literal: Jia Yingfu and Li You were seized in the inner guest office and brought out.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Yingfu and Li You were seized in the inner guest office and dragged out.

sentences.zh: 執蕭至忠、岑羲於朝，皆斬之。

translations.literal: At court Xiao Zhibo and Cen Yi were seized and all beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zhibo and Cen Yi were seized at court and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 睿宗明日下詔曰：「朕將高居無為，自今軍國政刑一事已上，並取皇帝處分。

translations.literal: The next day Ruizong issued an edict: "We shall dwell high and act through nonaction; from now on all military, state, penal, and administrative matters shall be decided by the emperor."
translations.idiomatic: Next day Ruizong decreed: "We shall dwell in nonaction; henceforth all military, state, penal, and civil affairs belong to the emperor."

sentences.zh: 」上御承天門樓，下制曰：

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the Tower of Accepting Heaven and issued an edict:
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mounted the Tower of Accepting Heaven and proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 丁卯，崔湜、盧藏用除名，長流嶺表。

translations.literal: On dingmao Cui Shi and Lu Zangyong were stripped of office and exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Cui Shi and Lu Zangyong were dismissed and exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，王琚為銀青光祿大夫、戶部尚書，封趙國公，實封三百戶；

translations.literal: On renshen Wang Ju became silver-blue-glow grandee and minister of revenue, enfeoffed as Duke of Zhao with a substantive fief of three hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Ju became silver-blue-glow grandee and minister of revenue, Duke of Zhao with three hundred households;

sentences.zh: 姜皎銀青光祿大夫、工部尚書，封楚國公，實封五百戶；

translations.literal: Jiang Jiao silver-blue-glow grandee and minister of works, enfeoffed as Duke of Chu with a substantive fief of five hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Jiao minister of works and Duke of Chu with five hundred households;

sentences.zh: 李令問銀青光祿大夫、殿中監，實封三百戶；

translations.literal: Li Lingwen silver-blue-glow grandee and director of the palace workshops, substantive fief of three hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: Li Lingwen director of palace workshops with three hundred households;

sentences.zh: 王毛仲輔國大將軍、左武衛大將軍、檢校內外閑廊兼知監牧使、霍國公，實封五百戶；

translations.literal: Wang Maozhong auxiliary state grand general, left martial guard grand general, acting superintendent of inner and outer stud farms and overseer of herds, Duke of Huo with a substantive fief of five hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Maozhong auxiliary state grand general, left martial guard general, overseer of stud farms, Duke of Huo with five hundred households;

sentences.zh: 王守一銀青光祿大夫、太常卿同正員，進封晉國公，實封五百戶：並賞其定策功。

translations.literal: Wang Shouyi silver-blue-glow grandee and acting grand master of splendid rites, advanced to Duke of Jin with a substantive fief of five hundred households—all rewarded for settling the plot.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shouyi acting grand master of splendid rites, advanced to Duke of Jin with five hundred households—all rewarded for the coup.

sentences.zh: 琚、皎、令問固讓。

translations.literal: Ju, Jiao, and Lingwen firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Ju, Jiao, and Lingwen all declined firmly.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，中書侍郎陸象先為益州大都督府長史兼劍南道按察兵馬使，尚書左丞張說為檢校中書令。

translations.literal: On guichou Secretariat Vice Director Lu Xiangxian became chief administrator of Yizhou metropolitan prefecture and inspection commissioner for Jiannan military affairs; Left Assistant in the Department of State Affairs Zhang Yue became acting secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Lu Xiangxian became Yizhou chief administrator and Jiannan inspection commissioner; Zhang Yue became acting secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，令毀天樞，取其銅鐵充軍國雜用。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he ordered the Heavenly Axis destroyed and its bronze and iron used for military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he ordered the Heavenly Axis torn down and its metal cast for military use.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，王琚為中書侍郎，加實封二百戶；

translations.literal: On gengchen Wang Ju became secretariat vice director with two hundred added households in his fief;
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Wang Ju became secretariat vice director with two hundred added fief households;

sentences.zh: 姜皎殿中監，仍充內外閑廄使，加實封二百戶；

translations.literal: Jiang Jiao director of the palace workshops, still superintendent of inner and outer stud farms, with two hundred added households in his fief;
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Jiao director of palace workshops and stud superintendent with two hundred added households;

sentences.zh: 李令問殿中少監、知尚食事，加實封二百戶。

translations.literal: Li Lingwen vice director of the palace workshops and overseer of imperial food, with two hundred added households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: Li Lingwen vice director of palace workshops and overseer of imperial food with two hundred added households.

sentences.zh: 己丑，周孝明高皇帝依舊追贈太原王，宜去帝號；

translations.literal: On jichou the High Emperor Xiaoming of Zhou was posthumously restored as Prince of Taiyuan, and the imperial title was removed;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Zhou High Emperor Xiaoming was posthumously restored as Prince of Taiyuan and stripped of the imperial title;

sentences.zh: 孝明皇后宜稱太原王妃；

translations.literal: Empress Xiaoming was to be called Princess of Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaoming was to be styled Princess of Taiyuan;

sentences.zh: 昊陵、順陵並稱太原王及妃墓。

translations.literal: the Haoling and Shunling tombs were both to be called the tombs of the Prince of Taiyuan and his consort.
translations.idiomatic: Haoling and Shunling were renamed the tombs of the Prince of Taiyuan and consort.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，封州流人劉幽求為尚書左僕射、知軍國重事、徐國公，仍依舊實封七百戶。

translations.literal: On renchen of the eighth month the exiled Liu Youqiu of Feng Prefecture was made Left Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, in charge of weighty state affairs, Duke of Xu, still with his former substantive fief of seven hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Liu Youqiu, exiled from Feng Prefecture, became left vice minister of state, in charge of weighty affairs, Duke of Xu, keeping his seven-hundred-household fief.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「凡有刑人，國家常法。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Whenever there is punishment, it is the state's constant law.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Punishment is the state's constant law.

sentences.zh: 掩骼埋胔，王者用心。

translations.literal: To gather bones and bury flesh is the king's heart."
translations.idiomatic: To gather bones and bury flesh is the king's care."

sentences.zh: 自今已後，輒有屠割刑人骨肉者，依法科殘害之罪。

translations.literal: From now on, whoever butchers or mutilates the flesh of the punished shall be sentenced under the law for cruel injury."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth whoever butchers or mutilates the flesh of the condemned shall be punished for cruel injury."
[End of edict.]

sentences.zh: 九月，司空兼揚州大都督、宋王成器為太尉兼揚州大都督，益州大都督兼右金吾大將軍、申王成義為司徒兼益州大都督，單于大都護兼左金吾大將軍、邠王守禮為司空。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Minister of Works and concurrent Yangzhou chief administrator Prince Chengqi of Song became Grand Mentor and concurrent Yangzhou chief administrator; Yizhou chief administrator and concurrent Right Golden Guard grand general Prince Chengyi of Shen became Minister of Education and concurrent Yizhou chief administrator; Chanyu Protectorate-general and concurrent Left Golden Guard grand general Prince Shouli of Bin became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Prince Chengqi of Song became grand mentor and Yangzhou governor; Prince Chengyi of Shen became minister of education and Yizhou governor; Prince Shouli of Bin became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，封華嶽神為金天王。

translations.literal: On guichou Mount Hua's spirit was enfeoffed as King of Metal Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the spirit of Mount Hua was enfeoffed as King of Metal Heaven.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，宋王成器為開府儀同三司，尚書左僕射劉幽求同中書門下三品，檢校中書令、燕國公張說為中書令，特進王仁皎為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On dingmao of the ninth month Prince Chengqi of Song became commissioner with the same privileges as the Three Dukes; Left Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs Liu Youqiu was equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery; acting Secretariat Director Zhang Yue, Duke of Yan, became Secretariat Director; Special Advance Wang Renjiao became commissioner with the same privileges as the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the ninth month Prince Chengqi became commissioner equal to the Three Dukes; Liu Youqiu joined the third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery; Zhang Yue became secretariat director; Wang Renjiao became commissioner equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 己卯，宴王公百僚於承天門，令左右於樓下撒金錢，許中書門下五品已上官及諸司三品已上官爭拾之，仍賜物有差。

translations.literal: On jimao he feasted the princes and the hundred officials at the Gate of Accepting Heaven, ordered coins scattered from the tower below for officials of the fifth rank and above at the Secretariat Chancellery and of the third rank and above in the ministries to scramble for, and granted goods in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he feasted princes and officials at the Gate of Accepting Heaven, showered gold from the tower for fifth-rank secretariat officials and third-rank ministry officials to scramble for, and gave graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 郭元振兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: Guo Yuanzhen was made concurrent censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yuanzhen became concurrent censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，又置右御史臺。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Right Censorate was established again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the right censorate was restored.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on jiashen, he visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on jiashen, he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，講武於驪山。

translations.literal: On guimao he reviewed troops at Mount Li.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he held a military review at Mount Li.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書、代國公郭元振坐虧失軍容，配流新州；

translations.literal: Minister of War and Duke of Dai Guo Yuanzhen was punished for dereliction in military appearance and exiled to Xin Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yuanzhen, minister of war and Duke of Dai, was exiled to Xin Prefecture for dereliction in military appearance;

sentences.zh: 給事中、攝太常少卿唐紹以軍禮有失，斬於纛下。

translations.literal: Drafting attendant and acting Vice Director of Court Ceremonies Tang Shao was beheaded beneath the army banners for faults in military rites.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shao, drafting attendant and acting vice director of court ceremonies, was beheaded beneath the banners for faults in military rites.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，畋獵於渭川。

translations.literal: On jiachen he hunted on the Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he hunted along the Wei.

sentences.zh: 同州刺史、梁國公姚元之為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Tongzhou prefect and Duke of Liang Yao Yuanzhi became Minister of War and equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanzhi, Tongzhou prefect and Duke of Liang, became minister of war of third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On yisi he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he came back from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，幽求兼知侍中。

translations.literal: On yichou Youqiu was made concurrent attendant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Liu Youqiu became concurrent attendant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上加尊號為開元神武皇帝。

translations.literal: On wuzi the emperor's honorific was extended to Martial Divine Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the emperor took the added title Martial Divine Emperor.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅朔，大赦天下，改元為開元，內外官賜勛一轉。

translations.literal: On the gengyin new moon of the twelfth month a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the era name was changed to Kaiyuan, and civil and military officials received one turn on the merit roll.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the twelfth month the court proclaimed amnesty, renamed the era Kaiyuan, and granted officials one merit turn.

sentences.zh: 改尚書左、右僕射為左、右丞相，中書省為紫微省，門下省為黃門省，侍中為監。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Vice Ministers of the Department of State Affairs were renamed Left and Right Chancellors; the Secretariat was renamed the Purple Palace Office; the Chancellery was renamed the Yellow Gate Office; Attendant-in-Chief was renamed Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right vice ministers became left and right chancellors; the secretariat became the Purple Palace Office; the chancellery the Yellow Gate Office; attendant-in-chief became supervisor.

sentences.zh: 雍州為京兆府，洛州為河南府，長史為尹，司馬為少尹。

translations.literal: Yong Prefecture became the metropolitan prefecture of Jingzhao, Luoyang the metropolitan prefecture of Henan; chief administrators were renamed prefects and assistants renamed vice prefects.
translations.idiomatic: Yong became Jingzhao metropolitan prefecture and Luoyang Henan metropolitan prefecture; chief administrators became prefects and assistants vice prefects.

sentences.zh: 國初以來宰相及食實封功臣子孫，一應沉翳未承恩者，令量才擢用。

translations.literal: Since the founding, descendants of chancellors and merit-fief holders who had sunk into obscurity without receiving favor were ordered appointed according to their talents.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of founding chancellors and merit-fief holders long overlooked were ordered appointed by talent.

sentences.zh: 開元元年十二月己亥，禁斷潑寒胡戲。

translations.literal: On jihai of the twelfth month of Kaiyuan 1 the Cold-Dispelling Hu play was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of Kaiyuan 1 the Cold-Dispelling Hu play was banned.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，尚書左丞相兼黃門監劉幽求為太子少保，罷知政事；

translations.literal: Left Chancellor and concurrent Yellow Gate Supervisor Liu Youqiu became Mentor of the Heir Apparent and ceased participation in government;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Youqiu, left chancellor and yellow gate supervisor, became mentor of the heir apparent and left the council;

sentences.zh: 紫微令張說為相州刺史。

translations.literal: Purple Palace Director Zhang Yue became prefect of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue became prefect of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，門下侍郎盧懷慎同紫微黃門平章事。

translations.literal: On jiayin Yellow Gate Vice Director Lu Huaizhen became equal in rank to the Purple Palace and Yellow Gate Offices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Lu Huaizhen joined the third rank at the Purple Palace and Yellow Gate Offices.

sentences.zh: 開元二年二年春正月，關中自去秋至於是月不雨，人多饑乏，遣使賑給。

translations.literal: In the first spring month of Kaiyuan 2, from the previous autumn until this month Guanzhong had no rain; many people were hungry, and envoys were sent with relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of Kaiyuan 2 Guanzhong had had no rain since the previous autumn; famine spread and envoys were sent with relief.

sentences.zh: 制求直諫昌言弘益政理者。

translations.literal: An edict sought forthright remonstrance and words that would benefit government.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for frank remonstrance and counsel that would improve government.

sentences.zh: 名山大川，並令祈祭。

translations.literal: Famous mountains and great rivers were all ordered to receive sacrificial prayers.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices were ordered at famous mountains and great rivers.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，紫微令姚崇上言請檢責天下僧尼，以偽濫還俗者二萬餘人。

translations.literal: On bingyin Purple Palace Director Yao Chong memorialized requesting inspection of monks and nuns throughout the realm; more than twenty thousand false ordinations were returned to lay life.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yao Chong asked to inspect monks and nuns empire-wide; more than twenty thousand false ordinations were laicized.

sentences.zh: 甲申，並州大都督府長史兼檢校左衛大將軍薛訥同紫微黃門三品，仍總兵以討奚、契丹。

translations.literal: On jiashen Bingzhou chief administrator and concurrent acting Left Guard grand general Xue Ne was equal in rank to the Purple Palace and Yellow Gate Offices and still commanded troops to campaign against the Xi and Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Xue Ne of Bingzhou joined the third rank at the Purple Palace and Yellow Gate Offices and still led troops against the Xi and Khitan.

sentences.zh: 二月，突厥默啜遣其子同俄特勤率眾寇北庭都護府，右驍衛將軍郭虔瓘擊敗之，斬同俄於城下。

translations.literal: In the second month the Turk qaghan Mojilie sent his son Tong'e Tegin with troops to raid the Protectorate of the North Court; Right Swift-Cavalry general Guo Zhenzhen defeated them and beheaded Tong'e beneath the wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Turk Mojilie sent his son Tong'e Tegin against the North Court; Guo Zhenzhen crushed them and beheaded Tong'e at the wall.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以旱，親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On jiyou, because of drought, he personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, in drought, he reviewed prisoners in person.

sentences.zh: 改太史監罷隸秘書省。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy was changed and removed from subordination to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy was reorganized and removed from the secretariat's oversight.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸亥，令道士、女冠、僧尼致拜父母。

translations.literal: On the guihai new moon of the intercalary month Daoists, female Daoists, monks, and nuns were ordered to perform obeisance to their parents.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the intercalary month Daoists, nuns, monks, and nuns were ordered to bow to their parents.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，復置十道按察使。

translations.literal: On dingmao the ten-circuit inspection commissioners were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the ten-circuit inspection commissioners were reinstated.

sentences.zh: 己未，突厥默啜妹婿火拔頡利發石失畢與其妻來奔，封燕山郡王，授左衛員外大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei Huoba Telifa Shishi and his wife, Mojilie's brother-in-law, came to defect and were enfeoffed as Prince of Yanshan commandery and made acting left guard assistant grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Huoba Telifa Shishi, Mojilie's brother-in-law, and his wife defected; he was made Prince of Yanshan and acting left guard assistant general.

sentences.zh: 紫微侍郎、趙國公王琚左授澤州刺史，賜實封一百戶，餘並停。

translations.literal: Purple Palace Vice Director and Duke of Zhao Wang Ju was demoted to prefect of Ze Prefecture with one hundred households in his fief; the rest of his rewards ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ju, purple palace vice director and Duke of Zhao, was demoted to Ze Prefecture with a hundred fief households; other rewards ceased.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，劉幽求為睦州刺史。

translations.literal: On dinghai Liu Youqiu became prefect of Mu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Liu Youqiu was sent to Mu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，青州刺史、郇國公韋安石為沔州別駕；

translations.literal: On jiachen of the third month Qingzhou prefect and Duke of Xun Wei Anshi became acting prefect of Mian Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wei Anshi, Qingzhou prefect and Duke of Xun, became acting prefect of Mian;

sentences.zh: 太子賓客、逍遙公韋嗣立為岳州別駕；

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Mentor and Duke of Xiaoyao Wei Sili became acting prefect of Yue Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Sili, heir apparent mentor and Duke of Xiaoyao, became acting prefect of Yue;

sentences.zh: 特進致仕李嶠先隨子在袁州，又貶滁州別駕：並員外置。

translations.literal: Special Advance in retirement Li Qiao, who had first followed his son to Yuan Prefecture, was further demoted to acting prefect of Chu Prefecture—all supernumerary appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiao, special advance in retirement, first exiled with his son to Yuan and then demoted to acting Chu prefect—all supernumerary posts.

sentences.zh: 去年九月有詔毀天樞，至今春始。

translations.literal: Last ninth month there had been an edict to destroy the Heavenly Axis; only this spring was it carried out.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to destroy the Heavenly Axis had come last autumn; work began only this spring.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛亥，黃門監魏知古工部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: In the fifth summer month, on xinhai, Yellow Gate Supervisor Wei Zhigu became Minister of Works and ceased participation in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month, on xinhai, Wei Zhigu, yellow gate supervisor, became minister of works and left the council.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，開府儀同三司、宋王成器為岐州刺史，司徒、申王成義為豳州刺史，司空、邠王守禮為虢州刺史：委務於上佐。

translations.literal: On dingsi Prince Chengqi of Song became prefect of Qi Prefecture, Prince Chengyi of Shen prefect of Bin Prefecture, and Prince Shouli of Bin prefect of Guo Prefecture—all affairs were entrusted to their aides.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Princes Chengqi, Chengyi, and Shouli were sent to Qi, Bin, and Guo as nominal prefects and left governing to their aides.

sentences.zh: 內出珠玉錦繡等服玩，又令於正殿前焚之。

translations.literal: Pearls, jade, brocades, and other garments and curios issued from the inner palace were ordered burned before the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: Pearls, jade, brocades, and palace finery were ordered burned before the main hall.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，兵部尚書致仕、韓國公張仁願卒。

translations.literal: On yichou Zhang Rengui, minister of war in retirement and Duke of Han, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhang Rengui, retired minister of war and Duke of Han, died.

sentences.zh: 七月，薛訥與副將杜賓客、崔宣道等總兵六萬自檀州道遇賊於灤河，為賊所敗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Xue Ne and deputy generals Du Binke, Cui Xuandao, and others with sixty thousand men on the Tanzhou route met the enemy on the Luan River and were defeated by them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Xue Ne and deputies Du Binke and Cui Xuandao led sixty thousand men on the Tanzhou route to the Luan River and were routed.

sentences.zh: 訥等屏甲遁歸，減死，除名為庶人。

translations.literal: Ne and the others cast off their armor and fled back; their death sentences were commuted and they were stripped of office and made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ne and the rest shed armor and fled; death was commuted to removal from office and commoner status.

sentences.zh: 辛未，光祿卿竇希瑊為太子太傅。

translations.literal: On xinwei Dou Xixian became Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Dou Xixian became grand mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 房州刺史、襄王重茂薨於梁州，謚曰殤帝。

translations.literal: Prince Chongmao of Xiang died at Liang Prefecture; his posthumous title was Emperor Shang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chongmao of Xiang died at Liang; he was posthumously styled Emperor Shang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，昭文館學士柳沖、太子左庶子劉子玄刊定《姓族系錄》二百卷，上之。

translations.literal: On bingwu Zhaowen Institute scholar Liu Chong and Left Heir Apparent Liu Zixuan completed the two hundred juan Genealogies of Clans and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Liu Chong and Liu Zixuan finished the two-hundred-juan Genealogies of Clans and presented them.

sentences.zh: 以興慶裏舊邸為興慶宮。

translations.literal: The former residence in Xingqing ward was made Xingqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His old mansion in Xingqing ward became Xingqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 諸王傅並停。

translations.literal: Tutors to the princes were all discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: All princely tutors were abolished.

sentences.zh: 京官所帶跨巾算袋，每朝參日著，外官衙日著，餘日停。

translations.literal: Capital officials' cross-sashes and tally-pouches were to be worn on audience days; outer officials on yamen days; on other days they ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials wore cross-sashes and tally-pouches on audience days, outer officials on yamen days, and neither on other days.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇臨洮軍，又游寇蘭州、渭州，掠群牧，起薛訥攝左羽林將軍、隴右防禦使，率杜賓客、郭知運、王晙、安思順以御之。

translations.literal: Tibet raided the Lintao army; it also ranged to raid Lan and Wei prefectures, plundering herd stations; Xue Ne was appointed acting left feathered-forest general and Longyou defense commissioner, leading Du Binke, Guo Zhiyun, Wang Jun, and An Sishun to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided Lintao and ranged through Lan and Wei, plundering herds; Xue Ne became acting left feathered-forest general and Longyou commissioner, leading Du Binke, Guo Zhiyun, Wang Jun, and An Sishun against them.

sentences.zh: 太常卿、岐王範為華州刺史，秘書監、薛王業為同州刺史。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Rites and Prince of Qi Fan became prefect of Hua Prefecture; Secretary Director and Prince of Xue Ye became prefect of Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Fan of Qi became Hua prefect; Prince Ye of Xue became Tong prefect.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，西天竺國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the eighth month western India sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu western India sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，幸新豐之溫泉。

translations.literal: On wushen of the ninth month he visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the ninth month he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，制曰：「自古帝王皆以厚葬為誡，以其無益亡者，有損生業故也。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict said: "From antiquity emperors and kings have taken lavish burial as a warning, because it does no good to the dead and harms the living."
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict said: "Since antiquity sage kings have warned against lavish burial—it profits the dead nothing and harms the living."

sentences.zh: 近代以來，共行奢靡，遞相仿效，浸成風俗，既竭家產，多至凋弊。

translations.literal: In recent times extravagance has been practiced in succession, each imitating the last until it became custom, draining households and often bringing ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Lately extravagance spread by imitation until custom drained households and brought ruin.

sentences.zh: 然則魂魄歸天，明精誠之已遠；

translations.literal: Yet the soul returns to heaven and the bright essence is already far;
translations.idiomatic: Yet the soul returns to heaven and the bright essence is far gone;

sentences.zh: 卜宅於地，蓋思慕之所存。

translations.literal: choosing a grave in earth is only where longing remains.
translations.idiomatic: choosing earth for a grave is only where longing remains.

sentences.zh: 古者不封，未為非達。

translations.literal: In antiquity there was no tumulus—this was not unenlightened.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients used no tumulus—that was not ignorance.

sentences.zh: 且墓為真宅，自便有房，今乃別造田園，名為下帳，又冥器等物，皆競驕侈。

translations.literal: The tomb is the true dwelling and already has its chambers; now separate estates are built and called "lower pavilions," and grave goods too are all competed in pride.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb is the true dwelling and already has chambers; now separate estates are built as "lower pavilions," and grave goods are rivaled in pride.

sentences.zh: 失禮違令，殊非所宜；

translations.literal: This violates ritual and statute and is not fitting;
translations.idiomatic: This violates ritual and law and is unfitting;

sentences.zh: 戮尸暴骸，實由於此。

translations.literal: exposing corpses and scattering bones truly springs from this.
translations.idiomatic: exposing corpses and scattering bones truly spring from this.

sentences.zh: 承前雖有約束，所司曾不申明，喪葬之家，無所依準。

translations.literal: Though there were earlier restrictions, the offices never made them clear, and mourning households had no standard.
translations.idiomatic: Though restrictions existed before, offices never enforced them and mourners had no standard.

sentences.zh: 宜令所司據品令高下，明為節制：冥器等物，仍定色數及長短大小；

translations.literal: Let the offices according to rank high and low set clear limits: grave goods shall have fixed colors and numbers and lengths and sizes;
translations.idiomatic: Offices shall set clear limits by rank: grave goods shall have fixed colors, numbers, and dimensions;

sentences.zh: 園宅下帳，並宜禁絕；

translations.literal: estate pavilions below the tomb are all forbidden;
translations.idiomatic: estate pavilions at the tomb are forbidden;

sentences.zh: 墳墓塋域，務遵簡儉；

translations.literal: tombs and burial grounds must follow simplicity;
translations.idiomatic: tombs and grounds must stay simple;

sentences.zh: 凡諸送終之具，並不得以金銀為飾。

translations.literal: all funerary objects must not use gold or silver for ornament.
translations.idiomatic: no funerary object may use gold or silver ornament.

sentences.zh: 如有違者，先決杖一百。

translations.literal: Whoever violates this shall first be beaten one hundred strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Violators shall first receive one hundred strokes.

sentences.zh: 州縣長官不能舉察，並貶授遠官。

translations.literal: Prefectural and county chiefs who fail to investigate shall all be demoted and sent to distant posts."
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates who fail to investigate shall be demoted to distant posts."
[End of edict.]

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，至自溫泉。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on wuwu, he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on wuwu, he came back from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 薛訥破吐蕃於渭州西界武階驛，斬首一萬七十級，馬七萬七匹，牛羊四萬頭。

translations.literal: Xue Ne defeated Tibet west of Wei Prefecture at the Wujie post station, beheading ten thousand seven hundred and taking seventy-seven thousand horses and forty thousand head of cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ne crushed Tibet west of Wei at Wujie post, taking ten thousand seven hundred heads, seventy-seven thousand horses, and forty thousand cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 豐安軍使郎將、判將軍王海賓先鋒力戰，死之。

translations.literal: Feng'an army commander and acting general Wang Haibin fought fiercely in the van and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Haibin, Feng'an commander and acting general, fought fiercely in the van and fell.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，葬殤帝於武功西原。

translations.literal: On gengyin Emperor Shang was buried on the western plain of Wugong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Emperor Shang was buried on Wugong's western plain.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，封皇子嗣真為鄫王，嗣初為鄂王，嗣玄為鄄王。

translations.literal: On yichou Princes Sizhen, Sichu, and Sixuan were enfeoffed as Prince of Zeng, Prince of E, and Prince of Yan respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Princes Sizhen, Sichu, and Sixuan were made princes of Zeng, E, and Yan.

sentences.zh: 時右威衛中郎將周慶立為安南市舶使，與波斯僧廣造奇巧，將以進內。

translations.literal: At that time Right Valiant Guard lieutenant Zhou Qingli served as Annan maritime trade commissioner and, with the Persian monk Guangzao, devised strange contrivances to present within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Right valiant guard lieutenant Zhou Qingli, Annan maritime trade commissioner, and the Persian monk Guangzao devised curios for the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 監選使、殿中侍御史柳澤上書諫，上嘉訥之。

translations.literal: Selection supervisor and palace attendant Liu Ze memorialized in remonstrance; the emperor praised his frankness.
translations.idiomatic: Selection supervisor Liu Ze remonstrated; the emperor praised his frankness.

sentences.zh: 開元三年三年春正月丁亥，立郢王嗣謙為皇太子，降死罪已下，大酺三日。

translations.literal: In the first spring month of Kaiyuan 3, on dinghai, Prince Siqian of Ying was installed as crown prince; capital punishment and below were reduced in severity, and public feasting lasted three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of Kaiyuan 3, on dinghai, Prince Siqian of Ying was made crown prince; capital crimes were commuted and the realm feasted three days.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，黃門侍郎盧懷慎為檢校黃門監。

translations.literal: On guimao Yellow Gate Vice Director Lu Huaizhen became acting Yellow Gate Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Lu Huaizhen became acting yellow gate supervisor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，工部尚書魏知古卒。

translations.literal: On jiachen Minister of Works Wei Zhigu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wei Zhigu, minister of works, died.

sentences.zh: 二月，禁斷天下採捕鯉魚。

translations.literal: In the second month the catching of carp throughout the realm was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month carp fishing was banned empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 十姓部落左廂五咄六啜、右廂五弩失畢五俟斤，及高麗莫離支高文簡、都督鳷跌思太等，各率其眾自突厥相繼來奔，前後總二千餘帳。

translations.literal: The ten surnames' left wing—the five Dulu tribes—and right wing—the five Nushibi and five Irkin—and Goguryeo's Molichi Gao Wenjian, the Tiele chieftain Zhediesi Tai, and others each led their bands to defect from the Turks in succession; in all more than two thousand tents came.
translations.idiomatic: The Ten Surnames' left and right wings, Goguryeo's Molichi Gao Wenjian, Tiele chief Zhediesi Tai, and others led more than two thousand tents to defect from the Turks in succession.

sentences.zh: 析許州、唐州置仙州。

translations.literal: Xu and Tang prefectures were divided to establish Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xu and Tang were split to establish Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，岐王範兼虢州刺史，薛王業兼幽州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month Prince Fan of Qi was made concurrent prefect of Guo Prefecture and Prince Ye of Xue concurrent prefect of You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Prince Fan became concurrent Guo prefect and Prince Ye concurrent You prefect.

sentences.zh: 六月，山東諸州大蝗，飛則蔽景，下則食苗稼，聲如風雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month great locusts struck the Shandong prefectures; in flight they blotted the light, on the ground they devoured the crops, and their sound was like wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month locusts swarmed Shandong, blotting the sun, devouring the fields, roaring like wind and rain.

sentences.zh: 紫微令姚崇奏請差御史下諸道，促官吏遣人驅撲焚瘞，以救秋稼，從之。

translations.literal: Purple Palace Director Yao Chong memorialized requesting censors sent to each circuit to urge officials to drive and burn the pests and bury them, to save the autumn harvest; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Chong asked censors sent to every circuit to drive, burn, and bury locusts and save the harvest; the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，田收有獲，人不甚饑。

translations.literal: That year the fields yielded a harvest and the people were not greatly hungry.
translations.idiomatic: That year the harvest held and famine was mild.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，刑部尚書李日知卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Minister of Punishments Li Rizhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Li Rizhi, minister of punishments, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，制曰：「朕聽政之暇，常覽史籍，事關理道，實所留心，中有闕疑，時須質問。

translations.literal: An edict said: "In the leisure of hearing government I often read the histories; matters touching principle and the Way truly engage my heart, and where there are doubts I sometimes need to inquire."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "In leisure from government I read histories; matters of principle engage me, and doubts must be answered."

sentences.zh: 宜選耆儒博學一人，每日入內侍讀。

translations.literal: Let one aged Confucian of broad learning enter daily to lecture within.
translations.idiomatic: One aged Confucian scholar was to enter daily to lecture at court.

sentences.zh: 」以光祿卿馬懷素為左散騎常侍，與右散騎常侍褚無量並充侍讀。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Rites Ma Huaisu was made Left Regular Attendant and, with Right Regular Attendant Chu Wuliang, both served as lecturers.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Huaisu became left regular attendant and, with Chu Wuliang, served as court lecturers.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸郿縣之鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: On jiazi he visited the Fengquan hot springs in Mei County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he went to the Fengquan hot springs in Mei County.

sentences.zh: 十一月已卯，至自鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: On yimao he returned from the Fengquan hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he returned from Fengquan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: On yiyou he visited the Xinfeng hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，妖賊崔子巖等入相州作亂。

translations.literal: On dinghai the sorcerer-rebel Cui Ziyan and others entered Xiang Prefecture and rose in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the sorcerer Cui Ziyan and others rebelled in Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊子，州司討平之。

translations.literal: On wuzi the prefectural offices suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the prefectural forces put them down.

sentences.zh: 甲午，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On jiawu he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he came back from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，以軍器使為軍器監，置官員。

translations.literal: On gengwu the Armory Office was made the Armory Directorate and officials were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Armory Office became the Armory Directorate with a full staff.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no snow fell.

sentences.zh: 開元四年四年春正月癸未，尚衣奉御長孫昕恃以皇后妹婿，與其妹夫楊仙玉毆擊御史大夫李傑，上令朝堂斬昕以謝百官。

translations.literal: First month, guiwei, fourth year of Kaiyuan, spring: Palace Wardrobe Attendant Changsun Xin, relying on being the empress's sister's husband, and his brother-in-law Yang Xianyu beat and struck Censor-in-Chief Li Jie; the Emperor ordered Xin beheaded in the court hall before the hundred officials as amends.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month, on guiwei of Kaiyuan 4, wardrobe attendant Changsun Xin—backed by his tie to the empress's sister—and Yang Xianyu, his brother-in-law, assaulted censor-in-chief Li Jie; the emperor ordered Xin executed in open court to appease the bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 以陽和之月不可行刑，累表陳請，乃命杖殺之。

translations.literal: Because it was the month of yang harmony when executions were forbidden, he repeatedly memorialized in plea; he was then ordered beaten to death instead.
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists pleaded that yang-harmony month forbade killing; after repeated appeals the emperor commuted the sentence to beating Xin to death.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，宋王成器、申王成義以「成」字犯昭成皇后謚號，於是成器改名憲，成義改為捴。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Prince of Song Chengqing and Prince of Shen Chengyi, because the character cheng violated Empress Zhaocheng's posthumous title, Chengqing was renamed Xian and Chengyi was renamed Suo.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Princes Song and Shen, whose names bore the tabooed character cheng in Empress Zhaocheng's temple name, were renamed Xian and Suo.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書、中山郡公李乂卒。

translations.literal: Minister of Punishments and Duke of Zhongshan Li Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yi, minister of punishments and Duke of Zhongshan, died.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: Second month, bingchen: visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingchen, he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On dingmao, returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he returned from the springs.

sentences.zh: 以關中旱，遣使祈雨於驪山，應時澍雨。

translations.literal: Because Guanzhong suffered drought, envoys were sent to pray for rain at Mount Li; timely soaking rain followed.
translations.idiomatic: With Guanzhong in drought he sent envoys to pray for rain at Mount Li, and a timely downpour answered.

sentences.zh: 令以少牢致祭，仍禁斷樵採。

translations.literal: He ordered sacrifices with the lesser victim and forbade cutting firewood there.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered lesser-victim offerings and banned woodcutting on the mountain.

sentences.zh: 夏六月庚寅，月蝕既。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, gengyin: the moon was totally eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth summer month, on gengyin, the moon suffered a total eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太上皇崩於百福殿。

translations.literal: On guihai the Retired Emperor died in the Hall of Hundred Blessings.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the retired emperor Ruizong died in the Hall of Hundred Blessings.

sentences.zh: 辛未，京師、華、陜三州大風拔木。

translations.literal: On xinwei great winds in the capital and Hua and Shan prefectures uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei gales in the capital and in Hua and Shan prefectures tore trees up by the roots.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，突厥可汗默啜為九姓拔曳固所殺，斬其首送於京師。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Turk qaghan Mochuo was killed by the Nine Surnames Bayegu; his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Turk qaghan Mochuo was slain by the Bayegu of the Nine Surnames, and his head was sent to court.

sentences.zh: 默啜兄子小殺繼立為可汗。

translations.literal: Mochuo's nephew Xiaosha succeeded as qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: Mochuo's nephew Xiaosha succeeded him as qaghan.

sentences.zh: 是夏，山東、河南、河北蝗蟲大起，遣使分捕而瘞之。

translations.literal: That summer locusts swarmed in Shandong, Henan, and Hebei; envoys were sent to capture and bury them by region.
translations.idiomatic: That summer locusts ravaged Shandong, Henan, and Hebei; the court sent envoys to gather and bury them province by province.

sentences.zh: 其回紇、同羅、霫、勃曳固、僕固五部落來附，於大武軍北安置。

translations.literal: The Huihe, Tongluo, Xi, Bayegu, and Pugu tribes came to submit and were settled north of Dawu Army.
translations.idiomatic: The Huihe, Tongluo, Xi, Bayegu, and Pugu submitted and were resettled north of Dawu Army.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，分巂、雅二州置黎州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingshen: Xi and Ya prefectures were split to establish Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingshen, Li Prefecture was carved from Xi and Ya.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，戶部尚書、新除太子詹事畢構卒。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guichou: Minister of Revenue and newly appointed Tutor of the Heir Apparent Bi Gou died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the tenth winter month Bi Gou, minister of revenue and newly named tutor of the heir apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，葬睿宗大聖貞皇帝於橋陵。

translations.literal: On gengwu the Great Sagely Pure Emperor Ruizong was buried at Qiao Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Ruizong, the Great Sagely Pure Emperor, was interred at Qiao Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 以同州蒲城縣為奉先縣，隸京兆府。

translations.literal: Tong Prefecture's Pucheng County was made Fengxian County and placed under Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Pucheng in Tong Prefecture became Fengxian County under Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，徙中宗神主於西廟。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dinghai: Zhongzong's spirit tablet was moved to the western shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the eleventh month Zhongzong's spirit tablet was moved to the western shrine.

sentences.zh: 甲午，尚書左丞源乾曜為黃門侍郎、同紫微黃門平章事。

translations.literal: On jiawu Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Yuan Qianyao became Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and co-equal Ziwei Huangmen Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yuan Qianyao, left assistant director of state affairs, entered the council as vice director of the Yellow Gate and co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，黃門監兼吏部尚書盧懷慎卒。

translations.literal: On xinchou Yellow Gate Supervisor and concurrent Minister of Personnel Lu Huaishen died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Lu Huaishen, yellow gate supervisor and minister of personnel, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yimao: visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the twelfth month he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 其夜，定陵寢殿災。

translations.literal: That night fire destroyed the sleeping hall at Ding Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: That night fire consumed the sleeping hall at Ding Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On yichou, returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he returned from the springs.

sentences.zh: 尚書、廣平郡公宋璟為吏部尚書兼黃門監，紫微侍郎、許國公蘇頲同紫微黃門平章事。

translations.literal: Minister and Duke of Guangping Song Jing became Minister of Personnel and concurrent Yellow Gate Supervisor; Ziwei Vice Director and Duke of Xu Suo Ting became co-equal Ziwei Huangmen Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jing, Duke of Guangping, became minister of personnel and yellow gate supervisor; Suo Ting, Duke of Xu, joined the council as co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書兼紫微令、梁國公姚崇為開府儀同三司，黃門侍郎、安陽男源乾曜守京兆尹，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of War and concurrent Ziwei Director and Duke of Liang Yao Chong became Grand Mentor with the honorific Pillar of State; Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and Baron of Anyang Yuan Qianyao became acting Jingzhao intendant, all ceasing to manage government.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Chong, minister of war and ziwei director, was made pillar of state; Yuan Qianyao left the council to serve as acting Jingzhao intendant.

sentences.zh: 停十道採訪使。

translations.literal: The ten-circuit investigation commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished the ten-circuit investigation commissioners.

sentences.zh: 開元五年五年春正月壬寅朔，上以喪制不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Fifth year of Kaiyuan, spring, first month, renyin new moon: because of mourning regulations the Emperor did not receive court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the first spring month of Kaiyuan 5 he declined court congratulations while in mourning.

sentences.zh: 癸卯寅時，太廟屋壞，移神主於太極殿，上素服避正殿，輟朝五日，日躬親祭享。

translations.literal: On guimao at the yin hour the Ancestral Temple buildings collapsed; the spirit tablets were moved to the Hall of Supreme Pole; the Emperor wore plain robes and avoided the main hall, suspending court for five days and personally offering sacrifice each day.
translations.idiomatic: At the yin hour on guimao the ancestral temple collapsed; spirit tablets were moved to the Hall of Supreme Pole; the emperor wore mourning, avoided the main hall, halted court five days, and sacrificed in person daily.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸東都。

translations.literal: On xinhai, proceeded to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he went to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，昏霧四塞。

translations.literal: On wuchen dusk mist sealed the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen dusk mist walled in the capital on every side.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，至自東都，大赦天下，唯謀反大逆不在赦限，餘並宥之。

translations.literal: Second month, jiaxu: returned from the eastern capital and proclaimed a great amnesty throughout the realm; only treason and great sedition were excluded, all else pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the second month he returned from Luoyang and proclaimed a general amnesty—treason alone excepted.

sentences.zh: 河南百姓給復一年，河南、河北遭澇及蝗蟲處，無出今年地租。

translations.literal: The people of Henan were granted tax relief for one year; in Henan and Hebei where there had been floods and locusts, this year's land tax was not levied.
translations.idiomatic: Henan was granted a year's tax relief; flood- and locust-stricken parts of Henan and Hebei owed no land tax that year.

sentences.zh: 武德、貞觀以來勛臣子孫無位者，訪求其後奏聞；

translations.literal: Descendants of meritorious ministers since Wude and Zhenguan who held no office were sought out and reported;
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Wude and Zhenguan meritocrats without posts were sought and reported to the throne;

sentences.zh: 有嘉遁幽棲養高不仕者，州牧各以名薦。

translations.literal: those of lofty reclusion who lived in seclusion and would not serve were to be recommended by name by each prefectural governor.
translations.idiomatic: recluses of high character who refused office were to be nominated by name by their prefects.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，於柳城依舊置營州都督府。

translations.literal: Third month, gengxu: at Liucheng the former Yingzhou protectorate was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the third month the Yingzhou protectorate was re-established at Liucheng.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以辛景初女封為固安縣主，妻於奚首領饒樂郡王大酺。

translations.literal: On dingsi the daughter of Xin Jingchu was enfeoffed Princess of Guo'an and married to the Xi chieftain, Grand Prince of Raole Da Gu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Xin Jingchu's daughter was created Princess of Guo'an and married to the Xi chieftain Da Gu, Grand Prince of Raole.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，皇帝第九子嗣一薨，追封夏王，謚曰悼。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jichou: the Emperor's ninth son Siyi died and was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xia with the posthumous title Mournful.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the fourth summer month his ninth son Siyi died and was posthumously created Prince of Xia, posthumous name Mournful.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以則天拜洛受圖壇及碑文並顯聖侯廟，初因唐同泰偽造瑞石文所建，令即廢毀。

translations.literal: On jiawu the altar where Wu Zetian received the Luo chart and its stele inscription, and the Temple of the Manifest Sage first built when Tang Tongtai forged the auspicious stone inscription, were ordered destroyed at once.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he ordered demolished the altar and stele of Wu Zetian's Luo reception and the Manifest Sage temple Tang Tongtai had raised on a forged stone omen.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，鞏縣暴雨連月，山水泛濫，毀郭邑廬舍七百餘家，人死者七十二。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renwu: in Gong County torrential rain lasted a month; mountains and rivers overflowed, destroying more than seven hundred houses in the city and suburbs; seventy-two people died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the sixth month a month of rain in Gong County sent rivers over their banks, wrecking seven hundred homes and killing seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 汜水同日漂壞近河百姓二百餘家。

translations.literal: On the same day in Sishui nearly two hundred riverside households were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Sishui lost nearly two hundred households along the river.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，詔曰：「古者操皇綱執大象者，何嘗不上稽天道，下順人極，或變通以隨時，爰損益以成務。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiazi, edict: "In antiquity those who held the imperial net and grasped the great image—did they not look up to Heaven's Way and comply with the human pole, at times changing and adapting with the seasons, adding and subtracting to complete their tasks?
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the seventh month an edict declared: "Those who in old times held the imperial net and grasped the great image looked up to Heaven's Way and down to the human pole—now changing with the seasons, now adding or subtracting to finish the work.

sentences.zh: 且衢室創制，度堂以筵。

translations.literal: When the Hall of Circles was first established, the Hall of Measures used mats for measure.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hall of Circles was first built, the Hall of Measures counted its span in mats.

sentences.zh: 因之以禮神，是光孝德；

translations.literal: With these they worshipped the spirits—thus manifesting filial virtue;
translations.idiomatic: With them they worshipped the spirits and made filial virtue shine;

sentences.zh: 用之以布政，蓋稱視朔，先王所以厚人倫感天地者也。

translations.literal: with these they dispensed government—this was called viewing the first of the month; such is how former kings thickened human relations and moved Heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: with them they governed—this was "viewing the new moon"; so former kings deepened human ties and stirred Heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 少陽有位，上帝斯歆，此則神貴於不黷，禮殷於至敬。

translations.literal: When lesser yang has its place, the supreme god rejoices; thus the spirits value not being profaned and ritual flourishes in utmost reverence.
translations.idiomatic: When lesser yang holds its station the supreme god is pleased; spirits hate profanation, and ritual reaches its fullness in awe.

sentences.zh: 今之明堂，俯鄰宮掖，比之嚴祝，有異肅恭，茍非憲章，將何軌物？

translations.literal: Now the Bright Hall leans upon the palace quarters; compared with austere worship it lacks solemn respect—if it is not law and pattern, what will guide things?
translations.idiomatic: Today's Bright Hall huddles against the inner palace; beside strict rites it seems slack—without true pattern, what can order the realm?

sentences.zh: 由是禮官博士公卿大臣廣參群議，欽若前古，宜存露寢之式，用罷闢雍之號。

translations.literal: Therefore ritual officials, academicians, and grandees broadly debated; revering antiquity, they should keep the form of the open-air bedchamber and abolish the name Biyong.
translations.idiomatic: Ritualists, doctors, and ministers debated at length; honoring antiquity, they urged the open-air bedchamber form and an end to the name Biyong.

sentences.zh: 可改為乾元殿，每臨御依正殿禮。

translations.literal: It may be renamed Qianyuan Hall; whenever the Emperor holds court he shall follow the etiquette of the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: Let it be renamed Qianyuan Hall, and whenever the emperor holds court let him follow main-hall rites.
Thus ran the edict.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，改紫微省依舊為中書省，黃門省為門下省，黃門監為侍中。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renyin: Ziwei Directorate was restored as the Department of State Affairs, Yellow Gate as the Chancellery, and Yellow Gate Supervisor as Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the ninth month Ziwei was restored as the Secretariat, the Yellow Gate as the Chancellery, and its supervisor as palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，京師修太廟成。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingzi: repair of the capital Ancestral Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the tenth winter month repair of the capital ancestral temple was finished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔以故越王貞死非其罪，封故許王男琳為嗣越王，以繼其後。

translations.literal: On dingchou an edict stated that the former Prince of Yue Zhen had died not for his crime; Zhen's grandson Lin of the former Prince of Xu was enfeoffed as titular Prince of Yue to continue the line.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict held that Prince of Yue Zhen had been wrongly killed; his grandson Lin was created titular Prince of Yue to continue the house.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祔神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On wuyin the spirit tablets were enshrined in the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the spirit tablets were installed in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，契丹首領松漠郡王李失活來朝，以宗女為永樂公主以妻之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jihai: the Khitan chieftain Li Shihuo, Grand Prince of Songmo, came to court; an imperial daughter was made Princess of Yongle and given to him in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the eleventh month the Khitan chieftain Li Shihuo, Grand Prince of Songmo, came to court and received Princess Yongle in marriage.

sentences.zh: 司徒兼鄧州刺史、申王捴兼虢州刺史。

translations.literal: Grand Mentor and concurrent Dengzhou prefect Prince of Shen Suo was made concurrent Guo prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Suo, prince of Shen, grand mentor and Dengzhou prefect, was given concurrent command of Guo prefecture.

sentences.zh: 開元六年六年春正月丙辰朔，以未經大祥，不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Sixth year of Kaiyuan, spring, first month, bingchen new moon: because the great mourning period had not ended, court congratulations were not received.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of Kaiyuan 6 he again declined congratulations while mourning was incomplete.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禁斷天下諸州惡錢，行二銖四分已上好錢，不堪用者並即銷破復鑄。

translations.literal: On xinyou bad coin was forbidden throughout the realm; good coin of two zhu and four fen weight and above was to circulate; unusable coin was to be destroyed and recast.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he banned debased coin empire-wide and enforced good coin of at least two zhu four fen; the rest was melted down.

sentences.zh: 將作大匠韋湊上疏，請遷孝敬神主，別立義宗廟。

translations.literal: Director of Palace Construction Wei Cou memorialized requesting that the spirit tablet of the Mournful and Filial Emperor be moved and a separate Yizong shrine established.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Cou, director of palace construction, asked to move the Mournful and Filial Emperor's tablet and build a separate Yizong shrine.

sentences.zh: 以太子少師兼許州刺史、岐王範兼鄭州刺史。

translations.literal: Junior Tutor and concurrent Xuzhou prefect Prince of Qi Fan was made concurrent Zhengzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Fan, prince of Qi and junior tutor, was given concurrent Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，禮幣徵嵩山隱士盧鴻。

translations.literal: Second month, jiaxu: with ritual gifts the recluse of Mount Song Lu Hong was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the second month Lu Hong, hermit of Mount Song, was summoned with ritual gifts.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙未，孝敬哀皇后祔於恭陵。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, yiwei: the Mournful and Filial Empress was enshrined at Gong Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the fifth summer month the Mournful and Filial Empress was installed at Gong Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 契丹松漠郡王李失活卒。

translations.literal: The Khitan Grand Prince of Songmo Li Shihuo died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shihuo, Khitan Grand Prince of Songmo, died.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，瀍水暴漲，壞人廬舍，溺殺千餘人。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiashen: the Chan River rose in flood and destroyed houses; more than a thousand people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the sixth month the Chan River burst its banks, wrecking homes and drowning more than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，制以故侍中桓彥範敬暉、故中書令兼吏部尚書張柬之、故特進崔玄暐、故中書令袁恕己配饗中宗廟庭，故司空蘇瑰、故左丞相太子少保郴州刺史劉幽求配饗睿宗廟庭。
