translations.literal: On yiyou an edict ordered the late Attendant-in-Chief Huan Yanfan Jinghui, late Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Personnel Zhang Jianzhi, late Specially Advanced Cui Xuanwei, and late Director of the Secretariat Yuan Shuoji to share sacrifice in Zhongzong's temple court; the late Minister of Works Su Gui and late Left Chancellor and Junior Tutor Liu Youqiu to share sacrifice in Ruizong's temple court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict enshrined Huan Yanfan, Zhang Jianzhi, Cui Xuanwei, and Yuan Shuoji with Zhongzong; Su Gui and Liu Youqiu with Ruizong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月已未，秘書監馬懷素卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiwei: Director of the Palace Library Ma Huaisu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the seventh month Ma Huaisu, director of the palace library, died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，遣工部尚書劉知柔持節往河南道存問。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yiwei: Minister of Works Liu Zhirou was sent with staff of authority to comfort Henan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the ninth month Liu Zhirou, minister of works, was dispatched to comfort Henan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，車駕還京師。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingshen: the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the tenth winter month the emperor returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，至自東都。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinmao: returned from the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he came back from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，親謁太廟，回御承天門，詔：「七廟元皇帝已上三祖枝孫有失官序者，各與一人五品京官。

translations.literal: On bingchen he personally visited the Ancestral Temple; returning he held court at Chengtian Gate and issued an edict: "Among collateral descendants of the three ancestors above the Original Emperor in the seven temples who have lost official rank, each branch shall receive one fifth-rank capital appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he sacrificed at the ancestral temple, then held court at Chengtian Gate and decreed: "Collateral lines of the three ancestors above the Original Emperor who have fallen from office shall each receive one fifth-rank capital post.

sentences.zh: 內外官三品已上有廟者，各賜物三十匹，以備修祭服及俎豆。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of third rank and above who have temples shall each be granted thirty bolts of goods to prepare sacrificial robes and vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officials and above with family temples shall receive thirty bolts of silk for robes and ritual vessels.

sentences.zh: 」賜文武官有差。

translations.literal: " Civil and military officials were rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed; civil and military officials were rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，傳國八璽依舊改稱寶，符璽郎為符寶郎。

translations.literal: On yisi the eight seals transmitting the realm were again styled treasures; the Seal Officer was renamed Treasure Officer.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the eight dynastic seals were again called treasures and the seal office renamed the treasure office.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以開府儀同三司兼澤州刺史、宋王憲為涇州刺史，司徒兼虢州刺史、申王捴為絳州刺史，以太子少師兼鄭州刺史、岐王範為岐州刺史，以太子少保兼衛州刺史、薛王業為虢州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Pillar of State and concurrent Zezhou prefect Prince of Song Xian became Jing prefect; Grand Mentor and concurrent Guo prefect Prince of Shen Suo became Jiang prefect; Junior Tutor and concurrent Zhengzhou prefect Prince of Qi Fan became Qi prefect; Junior Guardian and concurrent Weizhou prefect Prince of Xue Ye became Guo prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month princes Xian, Suo, Fan, and Ye were rotated among Jing, Jiang, Qi, and Guo prefectures.

sentences.zh: 開元七年七年春正月，吐蕃遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Seventh year of Kaiyuan, spring, first month: Tibet sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of Kaiyuan 7 Tibet sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，左武衛大將軍、霍國公王毛仲加特進。

translations.literal: Third month, dingyou: Left Martial Guard Grand General and Duke of Huo Wang Maoqi was made specially advanced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the third month Wang Maoqi, left martial guard grand general and Duke of Huo, was made specially advanced.

sentences.zh: 渤海靺鞨郡王大祚榮死，其子武藝嗣位。

translations.literal: Bohai Mohe Grand Prince Da Zuerong died; his son Wuyi succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Da Zuerong, Bohai Mohe grand prince, died; his son Wuyi succeeded.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，開府儀同三司王仁皎薨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guiyou: Pillar of State Wang Renjiao died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the fourth summer month Wang Renjiao, pillar of state, died.

sentences.zh: 五月已丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jichou new moon: the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon of the fifth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，制以亢陽日久，上親錄囚徙，多所原免。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingchen, edict: because drought had long persisted, the Emperor personally reviewed prisoners and pardoned many.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the seventh month, drought lingering, he personally reviewed prisoners and pardoned many.

sentences.zh: 諸州委州牧、縣宰量事處置。

translations.literal: Each prefecture was to have its governor and magistrate dispose of matters according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and magistrates were to handle local needs as they saw fit.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，敕：「周公制禮，歷代不刊；

translations.literal: Eighth month, guichou, edict: "The Duke of Zhou established rites, unaltered through the ages;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the eighth month an edict declared: "The Duke of Zhou made rites that ages have not erased;

sentences.zh: 子夏為傳，孔門所受。

translations.literal: Zixia transmitted them, received within the Confucian gate.
translations.idiomatic: Zixia handed them down within Confucius's school.

sentences.zh: 逮及諸家，或變例。

translations.literal: Down to the various schools, some altered the precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Later schools sometimes changed the precedents.

sentences.zh: 與其改作，不如好古。

translations.literal: Rather than revise them, it is better to honor antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Better to honor antiquity than to revise.

sentences.zh: 諸服紀宜一依舊文。

translations.literal: All mourning grades shall follow the old texts.
translations.idiomatic: Every grade of mourning shall follow the ancient statutes.
Thus ran the edict.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，改昭文館依舊為弘文館。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiazi: Zhaowen Hall was restored as Hongwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the ninth month Zhaowen Hall was restored as Hongwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 宋王憲徙封寧王。

translations.literal: Prince of Song Xian was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xian of Song was re-enfeoffed Prince of Ning.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，於東都來庭縣廨置義宗廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: at the Laiting county seat in the eastern capital the Yizong shrine was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the Yizong shrine was set up at Laiting in Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: On xinmao, visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On guimao, returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he returned from the springs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇太子詣國學行齒胄禮，陪位官及學生賜物有差。

translations.literal: On wuyin the crown prince went to the Directorate of Education to perform the cishi rite; attending officials and students received gifts in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the crown prince performed the cishi rite at the Directorate of Education; officials and students received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，置弘文、崇文兩館讎校書郎官員。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingxu: collation officer posts were established at Hongwen and Chongwen halls.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the twelfth month collation officers were appointed at Hongwen and Chongwen halls.

sentences.zh: 開元八年八年春正月甲子朔，皇太子加元服。

translations.literal: Eighth year of Kaiyuan, spring, first month, jiazi new moon: the crown prince received the capping ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of Kaiyuan 8 the crown prince was capped.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇太子謁太廟。

translations.literal: On yichou the crown prince visited the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the crown prince sacrificed at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，會百官於太極殿，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On bingyin he assembled the hundred officials in the Hall of Supreme Pole and granted gifts in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he gathered officials in the Hall of Supreme Pole and gave graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 壬申，右散騎常侍、舒國公褚元量卒。

translations.literal: On renshen Right Regular Attendant and Duke of Shu Chu Yuanliang died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Chu Yuanliang, right regular attendant and Duke of Shu, died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，侍中宋璟為開府儀同三司，中書侍郎蘇頲為禮部尚書，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: On jimao Palace Attendant Song Jing was made Pillar of State; Vice Director of the Secretariat Suo Ting was made Minister of Rites; both ceased to manage government.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Song Jing became pillar of state and Suo Ting minister of rites; both left the council.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹源乾曜為黃門侍郎，並州大督府長史張嘉貞為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Jingzhao Intendant Yuan Qianyao became Vice Director of the Yellow Gate; Grand Protector of Bingzhou Zhang Jiazhen became Vice Director of the Secretariat; both became co-equal Zhongshu Menxia Chief Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Qianyao entered the council as yellow gate vice director; Zhang Jiazhen as secretariat vice director—both co-equal chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，皇子敏薨，追封懷王，謚曰哀。

translations.literal: Second month, dingyou: Prince Min died and was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Huai with the posthumous title Lamentable.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the second month Prince Min died and was posthumously created Prince of Huai, posthumous name Lamentable.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丁卯，源乾曜為侍中，張嘉貞為中書令。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, dingmao: Yuan Qianyao became Palace Attendant; Zhang Jiazhen became Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the fifth summer month Yuan Qianyao became palace attendant and Zhang Jiazhen secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 南天竺國遣使獻五色鸚鵡。

translations.literal: Southern Tianzhu sent envoys presenting a five-colored parrot.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tianzhu sent envoys with a five-colored parrot.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅夜，東都暴雨，穀水泛漲。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renyin night: the eastern capital suffered torrential rain and the Gu River flooded.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renyin in the sixth month a cloudburst at Luoyang sent the Gu River over its banks.

sentences.zh: 新安、澠池、河南、壽安、鞏縣等廬舍蕩盡，共九百六十一戶，溺死者八百一十五人。

translations.literal: In Xin'an, Mianchi, Henan, Shou'an, Gong County, and elsewhere houses were swept away—nine hundred sixty-one households in all; eight hundred fifteen people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Xin'an, Mianchi, Henan, Shou'an, and Gong lost nine hundred sixty-one households and eight hundred fifteen dead.

sentences.zh: 許、衛等州掌閑番兵溺者千一百四十八人。

translations.literal: In Xu and Wei prefectures, idle frontier guards who drowned numbered one thousand one hundred forty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In Xu and Wei, eleven hundred forty-eight idle frontier guards drowned.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，突厥欲谷寇甘、涼等州，涼州都督楊敬述為所敗，掠契苾部落而歸。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month: the Turk yabghu raided Gan and Liang prefectures; Liangzhou Protector Yang Jingshu was defeated and the Qibi tribes were carried off as he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Turk yabghu raided Gan and Liang; Yang Jingshu, protector of Liang, was beaten and the Qibi were carried off.

sentences.zh: 以御史大夫王晙為兵部尚書兼幽州都督，黃門侍郎韋抗為御史大夫、朔方總管以御之。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Wang Jun was made Minister of War and concurrent Youzhou Protector; Vice Director of the Yellow Gate Wei Kang was made Censor-in-Chief and Protector-General of Shuofang to defend against them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun became minister of war and Youzhou protector; Wei Kang, censor-in-chief and Shuofang protector-general, was sent to meet the threat.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太子少師兼岐州刺史、岐王範兼太子太傅，太子少保兼虢州刺史、薛王業為太子太保，餘並如故。

translations.literal: On jiazi Junior Tutor and concurrent Qi prefect Prince of Qi Fan was made Heir Apparent Grand Tutor; Junior Guardian and concurrent Guo prefect Prince of Xue Ye was made Heir Apparent Grand Guardian; the rest remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Princes Fan and Ye became grand tutor and grand guardian of the heir apparent; other posts stood unchanged.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，幸長春宮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinsi: visited Everlasting Spring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the tenth winter month he went to Everlasting Spring Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，畋於下邽。

translations.literal: On renwu, hunted at Xia Gui.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he went hunting at Xia Gui.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，至自長春宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yichou: returned from Everlasting Spring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the eleventh month he returned from Everlasting Spring Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，突厥寇涼州，殺人掠羊馬數萬計而去。

translations.literal: On xinwei Turks raided Liangzhou, killed people, and drove off tens of thousands of sheep and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Turks raided Liangzhou, slaughtered the people, and drove off tens of thousands of sheep and horses.

sentences.zh: 開元九年九年春正月丙辰，改蒲州為河中府，置中都。

translations.literal: Ninth year of Kaiyuan, spring, first month, bingchen: Pu Prefecture was made Hezhong Superior Prefecture and the Central Capital established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of Kaiyuan 9 Pu Prefecture became Hezhong superior prefecture with status as central capital.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: On bingyin, visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，蘭池州叛胡顯首偽稱葉護康待賓、安慕容，為多覽殺大將軍何黑奴，偽將軍石神奴、康鐵頭等，據長泉縣，攻陷六胡州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengyin: rebel Hu of Lanchi Prefecture, with the renegade chieftain Kang Taibin and An Murong, and the false generals Shi Shennu and Kang Tietou, seized Changquan County and overran the Six Hu Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the fourth summer month Lanchi Hu rebels under Kang Taibin seized Changquan and overran the Six Hu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書王晙發隴右諸軍及河東九姓掩討之。

translations.literal: Minister of War Wang Jun mobilized Longyou forces and the Nine Surnames of Hedong to attack and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun, minister of war, marched Longyou troops and Hedong Nine Surnames against them.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上親策試應制舉人於含元殿，謂曰：「古有三道，今減二策。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Emperor personally tested presentation scholars in the Hall of Accepting Primacy and said: "In antiquity there were three themes; now two are omitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he examined presentation scholars in the Hall of Accepting Primacy and said: "Antiquity knew three themes; today we drop two.

sentences.zh: 近無甲科，朕將存其上第，務收賢俊，用寧軍國。

translations.literal: Lately no first grade has been awarded; I wish to keep the top rank and gather the worthy to settle army and state.
translations.idiomatic: No first grade has lately been given; I mean to keep the top rank and gather talent to steady army and state.

sentences.zh: 」仍令有司設食。

translations.literal: " He also ordered the relevant offices to set out food.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the offices to set out a feast.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，罷中都，依舊為蒲州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wushen: the Central Capital was abolished and Pu restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the seventh month the central capital was abolished and Pu restored.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王晙破蘭池州叛胡，殺三萬五千騎。

translations.literal: On jiyou Wang Jun defeated the Lanchi rebels, killing thirty-five thousand horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Wang Jun broke the Lanchi rebels and killed thirty-five thousand horsemen.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，揚、潤等州暴風，發屋拔樹，漂損公私船舫一千餘只。

translations.literal: On bingchen violent winds in Yang and Run prefectures tore off roofs and uprooted trees, wrecking more than a thousand public and private boats.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen gales in Yang and Run tore off roofs, uprooted trees, and wrecked a thousand boats.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，集諸酋長，斬康待賓。

translations.literal: On xinyou he assembled the tribal chieftains and executed Kang Taibin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he assembled the chieftains and beheaded Kang Taibin.

sentences.zh: 先天中，重修三九射禮，至是，給事中許景先抗疏罷之。

translations.literal: In the Xiantian era the Triple Nine archery rite had been revised; now Supervising Attendant Xu Jingxian memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: The Triple Nine archery rite revised in Xiantian was abolished on Xu Jingxian's memorial.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jisi new moon: the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the ninth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，開府儀同三司、梁國公姚崇薨。

translations.literal: On dingwei Pillar of State and Duke of Liang Yao Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yao Chong, pillar of state and Duke of Liang, died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，御丹鳳樓，宴突厥首領。

translations.literal: On dingsi he held court at Crimson Phoenix Tower and feasted Turk chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he banqueted Turk chieftains at Crimson Phoenix Tower.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸中書省。

translations.literal: On gengshen, visited the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he visited the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，右羽林將軍、權檢校並州大都督府長史、燕國公張說為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On guihai Right Yulin General and Acting Grand Protector of Bingzhou Zhang Yue was made Minister of War and co-equal Zhongshu Menxia Third Grade.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Yue, right Yulin general and acting Bingzhou protector, became minister of war and co-equal third-grade chief minister.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙辰，左散騎常侍元行沖上《群書目錄》二百卷，藏之內府。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, bingchen: Left Regular Attendant Yuan Xingchong presented the Comprehensive Catalogue in two hundred juan, deposited in the inner storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the eleventh winter month Yuan Xingchong presented his two-hundred-juan Comprehensive Catalogue to the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 庚午冬至，大赦天下，內外官九品己上加一階，三品已上加爵一等。

translations.literal: On gengwu, winter solstice: great amnesty throughout the realm; civil and military officials of ninth rank and above received one step in rank, third rank and above one noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu solstice he proclaimed a general amnesty; officials of ninth rank and up gained one step, third rank and up one noble rank.

sentences.zh: 自六月二十日、七月三日匡衛社稷食實封功臣，坐事削除官爵，中間有生有死，並量加收贈。

translations.literal: Meritorious ministers who on the twentieth day of the sixth month and third day of the seventh had aided the altars of soil and grain with substantive fiefs, whether demoted or dead in the interval, were to be posthumously or retroactively honored as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Those who on the sixth month's twentieth day and seventh month's third had saved the dynasty with substantive fiefs—whether demoted or dead since—were to be honored or posthumously raised as fit.

sentences.zh: 致仕官合佩魚者聽其終身。

translations.literal: Retired officials entitled to wear the fish tally might keep it for life.
translations.idiomatic: Retired officials with fish-tally privilege might keep it for life.

sentences.zh: 賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Three days of public revelry were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was granted three days of revelry.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yiyou: visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the twelfth month he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On renwu, returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he returned from the springs.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no snow fell.

sentences.zh: 開元十年十年春正月丁巳，幸東都。

translations.literal: Tenth year of Kaiyuan, spring, first month, dingsi: proceeded to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the first spring month of Kaiyuan 10 he went to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，省王公已下視品官參佐及京三品已上官伏身職員。

translations.literal: On jiazi the supplementary staff and prostrating attendants of princes, dukes, and officials of viewing rank and above, and the prostrating staff of capital officials of third rank and above, were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he abolished extra staff and prostrating attendants for princes, dukes, and third-rank capital officials.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，停天下公廨錢，其官人料以稅戶錢充，每月準舊分例數給。

translations.literal: On yichou public-office money throughout the realm was halted; official salaries were to be paid from tax-household money according to the old monthly allotments.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou empire-wide public-office money was ended; salaries were paid from tax-household funds on the old monthly scale.

sentences.zh: 戊申，內外官職田，除公廨田園外，並官收，給還逃戶及貧下戶欠丁田。

translations.literal: On wushen official land for civil and military officers, except public-office fields and gardens, was all taken by the state and given to fleeing households and poor households lacking labor for their tax plots.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen official land except office fields and gardens was confiscated and given to fugitives and poor households short of labor for tax plots.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，至東都。

translations.literal: Second month, wuyin: arrived at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the second month he reached Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，詔自今內外官有犯贓至解免已上，縱逢赦免，並終身勿齒。

translations.literal: Third month, wushen, edict: from now on civil and military officials guilty of corruption up to dismissal, even if pardoned, shall never again be employed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the third month an edict barred forever from office any official dismissed for corruption, even under amnesty.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，封契丹首領松漠都督李鬱於為松漠郡王，奚首領饒樂都督李魯蘇為饒樂郡王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dingyou: Khitan chieftain Songmo Protector Li Yuzhou was enfeoffed Grand Prince of Songmo; Xi chieftain Raole Protector Li Lusu was enfeoffed Grand Prince of Raole.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the fourth summer month Li Yuzhou was created Grand Prince of Songmo and Li Lusu Grand Prince of Raole.

sentences.zh: 五月，東都大雨，伊、汝等水泛漲，漂壞河南府及許、汝、仙、陳等州廬舍數千家，溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Fifth month: great rain at the eastern capital; the Yi and Ru rivers flooded, destroying thousands of houses in Henan prefecture and Xu, Ru, Xian, and Chen prefectures; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month rain at Luoyang sent the Yi and Ru over their banks, wrecking thousands of homes from Henan to Chen; many drowned.

sentences.zh: 閏五月壬申，兵部尚書張說往朔方軍巡邊。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, renshen: Minister of War Zhang Yue went to Shuofang Army to inspect the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the intercalary fifth month Zhang Yue, minister of war, toured the Shuofang frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，敕諸番充質宿衛子弟，並放還國。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict released hostage youths of various tribes serving in the palace guard and sent them home.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict freed tribal hostages in the palace guard and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，上訓注《孝經》，頒於天下。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinchou: the Emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and promulgated it throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the sixth month he lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and promulgated it empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以餘姚縣主女慕容氏為燕郡公主，出降奚首領饒樂郡王李魯蘇。

translations.literal: On guimao the daughter of the Princess of Yuyao, Lady Murong, was made Princess of Yan Commandery and sent to marry the Xi chieftain Li Lusu, Grand Prince of Raole.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Princess of Yuyao's daughter Murong was created Princess of Yan Commandery and married to Li Lusu, Grand Prince of Raole.

sentences.zh: 己巳，增置京師太廟為九室，移孝和皇帝神主以就正廟。

translations.literal: On jisi the capital Ancestral Temple was enlarged to nine chambers and Emperor Xiaohé's spirit tablet was moved to the main temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the capital temple was expanded to nine chambers and Xiaohé's tablet placed in the main shrine.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙戌，嶺南按察使裴伷先上言安南賊帥梅叔鸞等攻圍州縣，遣驃騎將軍兼內侍楊思勖討之。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, bingxu: Lingnan Investigation Commissioner Pei Zhuxian reported that the Annan bandit chief Mei Shuluan and others were besieging prefectures and counties; General of Valiant Cavalry and concurrent Palace Attendant Yang Sixu was sent to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the eighth month Pei Zhuxian reported Mei Shuluan besieging Annan; Yang Sixu, valiant cavalry general and palace attendant, was sent against him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，遣戶部尚書陸象先往汝、許等州存撫賑給。

translations.literal: On dinghai Minister of Revenue Lu Xiangxian was sent to Ru and Xu prefectures to comfort and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Lu Xiangxian, minister of revenue, was dispatched to comfort and relieve Ru and Xu.

sentences.zh: 丙申，博、棣等州黃河堤破，漂損田稼。

translations.literal: On bingshen the Yellow River dike broke in Bo and Di prefectures, flooding fields.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Yellow River burst its dike in Bo and Di, drowning cropland.

sentences.zh: 九月，張說擒康願子於木盤山。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Zhang Yue captured Kang Yuanzi at Mount Mupan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhang Yue took Kang Yuanzi at Mount Mupan.

sentences.zh: 詔移河曲六州殘胡五萬餘口於許、汝、唐、鄧、仙、豫等州，始空河南朔方千里之地。

translations.literal: An edict moved more than fifty thousand remnant Hu of the six Hezhou prefectures to Xu, Ru, Tang, Deng, Xian, and Yu; for the first time the lands north of the river and Shuofang were emptied for a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: An edict resettled fifty thousand Hezhou Hu to the interior; for the first time the north-of-river and Shuofang corridor lay empty for a thousand li.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，秘書監、楚國公姜皎坐事，詔杖之六十，配流欽州，死於路。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Director of the Palace Library and Duke of Chu Jiang Jiao was guilty; he was ordered beaten sixty strokes and exiled to Qin Prefecture, dying on the road.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Jiang Jiao, director of the palace library and Duke of Chu, was beaten sixty strokes, exiled to Qin, and died on the road.

sentences.zh: 都水使者劉承祖配流雷州。

translations.literal: Director of Waterways Liu Chengzu was exiled to Lei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chengzu, director of waterways, was exiled to Lei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，制曰：「朕君臨宇內，子育黎元。

translations.literal: On yihai, edict: "I rule the realm and nurture the black-haired people.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict declared: "I rule the realm and nurture the people.

sentences.zh: 內修睦親，以敘九族；

translations.literal: Within I cultivate harmony among kin to order the nine agnates;
translations.idiomatic: Within I cultivate kinship to order the nine agnates;

sentences.zh: 外協庶政，以濟兆人。

translations.literal: without I harmonize the myriad tasks to aid the ten thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: without I harmonize government to aid the myriad folk.

sentences.zh: 勛戚加優厚之恩，兄弟盡友于之至。

translations.literal: Meritorious kin receive added grace; brothers should reach the fullness of fraternal duty.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious kin receive added grace; brothers should fulfill fraternal duty to the full.

sentences.zh: 務崇敦本，克慎明德。

translations.literal: I strive to honor the root and carefully cultivate bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: I strive to honor the root and cultivate bright virtue.

sentences.zh: 今小人作孽，已伏憲章，恐不逞之徒，猶未能息。

translations.literal: Now petty men have wrought evil and already suffered the law; I fear the unrestrained may not yet be stilled.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men have sinned and already paid the law; I fear the unrestrained are not yet stilled.

sentences.zh: 凡在宗屬，用申懲誡：自今已後，諸王、公主、駙馬、外戚家，除非至親以外，不得出入門庭，妄說言語。

translations.literal: All within the clan are warned: from now on princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and maternal kin, except for the nearest kin, may not pass in and out of one another's gates or speak rash words.
translations.idiomatic: The clan is warned: from now on princes, princesses, sons-in-law, and maternal kin—except nearest kin—may not enter one another's gates or speak rashly.

sentences.zh: 所以共存至公之道，永協和平之義，克固籓翰，以保厥休。

translations.literal: Thus the way of utmost fairness is preserved and peace long kept, the screen of the realm secured and rest assured.
translations.idiomatic: So utmost fairness may endure, peace hold, and the realm's screen stand firm.

sentences.zh: 貴戚懿親，宜書座右。

translations.literal: Noble kin and honored relations should write this at their seat.
translations.idiomatic: Noble kin should write this at their seat.

sentences.zh: 」又下制，約百官不得與卜祝之人交游來往。

translations.literal: " Another edict bound all officials not to associate or deal with diviners and shamans.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed. Another bound officials from consorting with diviners and shamans.

sentences.zh: 乙卯夜，京兆人權梁山偽稱襄王男，自號光帝，與其黨權楚璧，以屯營兵數百人，自景風、長樂等門斬關入宮城構逆。

translations.literal: On yimao night the capital man Quan Liangshan falsely styled himself son of the Prince of Xiang and called himself Emperor Guang, and with his follower Quan Chubi led several hundred garrison soldiers through the Jingfeng and Changle gates, cutting the bars to enter the palace and rebel.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yimao Quan Liangshan of the capital posed as the Prince of Xiang's son, styled himself Emperor Guang, and with Quan Chubi led hundreds of garrison troops through Jingfeng and Changle gates into the palace.

sentences.zh: 至曉兵敗，斬梁山，傳首東都。

translations.literal: By dawn the troops were defeated; Liangshan was beheaded and his head sent to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn they were broken; Liangshan was beheaded and his head sent to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 廢河陽柏崖倉。

translations.literal: The Heyang Ba Ya granary was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Ba Ya granary at Heyang was abolished.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，乾元殿依舊題為明堂。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guichou: Qianyuan Hall was again titled Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the tenth winter month Qianyuan Hall was again named Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸壽安之故興泰宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin, visited the former Xingtai Palace at Shou'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he visited the old Xingtai Palace at Shou'an.

sentences.zh: 畋獵於土宜川。

translations.literal: Hunted at Tuyi River.
translations.idiomatic: He hunted on the Tuyi River.

sentences.zh: 庚申，至自興泰宮。

translations.literal: On gengshen, returned from Xingtai Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he returned from Xingtai Palace.

sentences.zh: 波斯國遣使獻獅子。

translations.literal: Persia sent envoys presenting a lion.
translations.idiomatic: Persia sent envoys with a lion.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，初令宰相共食實封三百戶。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yiwei: for the first time chief ministers were granted a shared substantive fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the eleventh month chief ministers were for the first time granted a shared substantive fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 十二月，停按察使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: investigation commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month investigation commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 開元十一年十一年春正月丁卯，降都城見楚囚徒，流、死罪減一等，餘並原之。

translations.literal: Eleventh year of Kaiyuan, spring, first month, dingmao: capital convicts in chains were pardoned; exile and death sentences reduced one grade, the rest forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of Kaiyuan 11 chained capital convicts were pardoned—exile and death reduced one grade, the rest freed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，北都巡狩，敕所至處存問高年、鰥寡惸獨、征人之家；

translations.literal: On jisi he toured the northern capital; an edict ordered that wherever he passed the aged, widows, orphans, and solitary, and households of campaigners, be comforted;
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he toured Taiyuan; wherever he passed, the aged, widowed, orphaned, and soldiers' families were to be comforted;

sentences.zh: 減流、死罪一等，徒以下放免。

translations.literal: exile and death sentences reduced one grade; those below penal servitude released.
translations.idiomatic: exile and death were reduced one grade; penal servitude and below were freed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，幸並州、潞州，宴父老，曲赦大闢罪已下，給復五年。

translations.literal: On gengchen he visited Bing and Lu prefectures, feasted the elders, and by special pardon forgave capital crimes and below, granting tax relief for five years.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he feasted the elders of Bing and Lu and by special pardon forgave crimes through capital offense, with five years' tax relief.

sentences.zh: 別改其舊宅為飛龍宮。

translations.literal: His former residence was separately made Flying Dragon Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His old residence was made Flying Dragon Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改並州為太原府，官吏補授，一準京兆、河南兩府。

translations.literal: On xinmao Bingzhou was made Taiyuan Superior Prefecture; appointments of officials followed Jingzhao and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Bingzhou became Taiyuan superior prefecture with appointments like Jingzhao and Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 百姓給復一年，貧戶復二年，元從戶復五年。

translations.literal: The people received one year's tax relief; poor households two years; original followers five years.
translations.idiomatic: The people received one year's relief; the poor two; original followers five.

sentences.zh: 武德功臣及元從子孫，有才堪文武未有官者，委府縣搜揚，具以名薦。

translations.literal: Descendants of Wude meritocrats and original followers with civil or military talent but no office were to be searched out by prefecture and county and recommended by name.
translations.idiomatic: Talented but officeless descendants of Wude meritocrats and original followers were to be sought and recommended by name.

sentences.zh: 上親制《起義堂頌》及書，刻石紀功於太原府之南街。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally composed the "Ode to the Hall of Rising Justice" and calligraphy, carving stone to record merit on the south street of Taiyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He composed the "Ode to the Hall of Rising Justice" in his own hand and had merit carved in stone on Taiyuan's south street.

sentences.zh: 戊申，次晉州。

translations.literal: On wushen he halted at Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he paused at Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壇場使、中書令張嘉貞貶為幽州刺史。

translations.literal: Director of Sacrifices and Director of the Secretariat Zhang Jiazhen was demoted to prefect of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiazhen, director of sacrifices and secretariat director, was demoted to Youzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 壬子，祠后土於汾陰之脽上，升壇行事官三品已上加一爵，四品已上加一階，陪位官賜勛一轉。

translations.literal: On renzi he sacrificed to the earth at the She altar south of Fen; officials of third rank and above at the rite received one noble rank, fourth rank one step, attending officials one cycle of merit.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he sacrificed to earth at Fen's She altar; third rank and up gained a noble rank, fourth rank a step, attendees one merit cycle.

sentences.zh: 改汾陰為寶鼎縣。

translations.literal: Fenyin was renamed Baoding County.
translations.idiomatic: Fenyin county was renamed Baoding.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，兵部尚書張說兼中書令。

translations.literal: On guihai Minister of War Zhang Yue was made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Yue, minister of war, was made concurrent secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，車駕至京師，制所經州、府、縣無出今年地稅，京城見禁囚徒並原免之。

translations.literal: Third month, gengwu: the imperial carriage reached the capital; an edict ordered that prefectures, superior prefectures, and counties along the route pay no land tax this year, and capital prisoners in chains be forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the third month he reached Chang'an; the route owed no land tax that year and capital prisoners were freed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，遷祔中宗神主於太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingchen: Zhongzong's spirit tablet was moved to enshrinement in the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the fourth summer month Zhongzong's tablet was installed in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，張說正除中書令，吏部尚書、中山公王晙為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On guihai Zhang Yue was formally appointed Director of the Secretariat; Minister of Personnel and Duke of Zhongshan Wang Jun was made Minister of War and co-equal Zhongshu Menxia Third Grade.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Yue was confirmed secretariat director; Wang Jun, minister of personnel and Duke of Zhongshan, became minister of war and co-equal chief minister.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，北都置軍器監官員。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jisi: officer posts for the Armory Directorate were established at the northern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the fifth month armory directorate posts were established at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 王晙為朔方節度使，兼知河北郡、隴右、河西兵馬使。

translations.literal: Wang Jun became Shuofang military commissioner and concurrently overseer of Hebei, Longyou, and Hexi forces.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun became Shuofang commissioner and overseer of Hebei, Longyou, and Hexi troops.

sentences.zh: 六月，王晙赴朔方軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Wang Jun proceeded to Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wang Jun went to Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊申，尊八代祖宣皇帝廟號獻祖，光皇帝廟號懿祖，始祔於太廟之九廟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on wushen, the temple titles of the eight-generation ancestors the Propagating Emperor and the Radiant Emperor were fixed as Xianzu and Yizu and they were first enshrined in the nine temples of the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, on wushen, the Propagating and Radiant emperors were enshrined as Xianzu and Yizu in the Grand Temple’s nine shrines.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，頒上撰《廣濟方》於天下，仍令諸州各置醫博士一人。

translations.literal: On jisi of the ninth month, the self-authored Great Beneficial Formulas was promulgated throughout the realm; each prefecture was to appoint one medical instructor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor’s Great Beneficial Formulas went empire-wide, with one medical instructor per prefecture.

sentences.zh: 春秋二時釋奠，諸州宜依舊用牲牢，其屬縣用酒酺而已。

translations.literal: At the spring and autumn libations, prefectures should as before use oxen and sheep; subordinate counties need only offer wine and dried meat.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures kept full sacrificial beasts at the seasonal rites; counties offered wine and dried meat only.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，幸新豐之溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou, he visited the Hot Springs Palace at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he went to the Hot Springs at Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，至自溫泉。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he returned from the Hot Springs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he came back from the springs.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，親祀南郊，大赦天下，見禁囚徒死罪至徒流已下免除之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, he personally sacrificed at the southern suburb, proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven, and released prisoners from death through penal service.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he worshipped at the southern altar, amnestied the realm, and freed prisoners down to penal labor.

sentences.zh: 升壇行事及供奉官三品已上賜爵一級，四品轉一階。

translations.literal: Officials of third rank and above who performed the rite or served in attendance received one noble rank; those of fourth rank were promoted one step.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officers at the rite gained a noble grade; fourth-rank men rose one step.

sentences.zh: 武德以來實封功臣、知政宰輔淪屈者，所司具以狀聞。

translations.literal: Meritorious enfeoffees since Wude and chief ministers who had suffered wrongful demotion were to be reported by the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were to report meritorious enfeoffees and wronged chief ministers since Wude.

sentences.zh: 賜酺三日，京城五日。

translations.literal: The realm enjoyed great feasting for three days; the capital for five.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of public feasting were proclaimed; the capital feasted five.

sentences.zh: 是月，自京師至於山東、淮南大雪，平地三尺餘。

translations.literal: That month, from the capital east to Shandong and Huainan, heavy snow piled more than three feet in the level fields.
translations.idiomatic: That month snow buried the roads from the capital through Shandong and Huainan three feet deep.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，廢軍器監官員，少府監加置少監一人以充之。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the staff of the Directorate of Armaments was abolished; the Directorate of the Palace Workshops added one Vice Director to take their place.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Armaments directorate was folded into the Palace Workshops, with an added vice director.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，幸鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiawu, he visited the Phoenix Spring baths.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he went to the Phoenix Spring baths.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至自鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: On wushen, he returned from the Phoenix Spring baths.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he returned from Phoenix Spring.

sentences.zh: 庚申，王晙授蘄州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wang Jun was appointed Qizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Jun became governor of Qi.

sentences.zh: 開元十二年十二年春正月。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 12, in spring, the first month.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 12 opened in the first month of spring.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，封故澤王上金男義珣為嗣澤王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Yijun, son of the late Prince of Ze Shangjin, was enfeoffed as heir to the Prince of Ze.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Shangjin’s son Yijun succeeded as Prince of Ze.

sentences.zh: 嗣許王瓘左授鄂州別駕，以弟璆為上金嗣故也。

translations.literal: Heir Prince of Xu Guan was demoted to Ezhou vice-prefect because his younger brother Qiong had succeeded Prince Shangjin.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xu Guan was sent to Ezhou as vice-prefect when his brother Qiong took Shangjin’s title.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，嗣江王禕降為信安郡王，嗣蜀王示俞為廣漢郡王，嗣密王徹為濮陽郡王，嗣曹王臻為濟國公，嗣趙王琚為中山郡王，武陽郡王堪為澧國公。

translations.literal: On guimao, Heir Prince of Jiang Yi was reduced to Prince of Xin’an; Heir Prince of Shu Shiyu to Prince of Guanghan; Heir Prince of Mi Che to Prince of Puyang; Heir Prince of Cao Zhen to Duke of Ji; Heir Prince of Zhao Ju to Prince of Zhongshan; Prince of Wuyang Kan to Duke of Li.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the collateral heirs were demoted: Yi to Xin’an, Shiyu to Guanghan, Che to Puyang, Zhen to Duke of Ji, Ju to Zhongshan, Kan to Duke of Li.

sentences.zh: 禕等並自神龍之後外繼為王，以瓘利澤王之封，盡令歸宗改封焉。

translations.literal: Yi and the others had all been made kings by adoption after Shenlong; because Guan had coveted the Ze fief, they were all returned to the clan rolls and re-enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: These princes had been adopted into the line after Shenlong; Guan’s grasp for Ze’s title brought them all back to ordinary enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，月蝕既。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, there was a total eclipse of the moon.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the moon was wholly eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，廢皇后王氏為庶人。

translations.literal: On jimao, Empress Wang was deposed and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Empress Wang was cast down to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 後弟太子少保、駙馬都尉守一貶為澤州別駕，至藍田，賜死。

translations.literal: Her brother, the heir’s Junior Tutor and Commandant of the Horse, Shouyi, was demoted to Zezhou vice-prefect; at Lantian he was ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: Her brother Shouyi, the heir’s tutor and imperial son-in-law, was banished to Ze and ordered to die at Lantian.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書、河東伯張嘉貞貶臺州刺史。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue and Earl of Hedong Zhang Jiazhen was demoted to Taizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiazhen, Minister of Revenue and Earl of Hedong, was sent to govern Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月庚申，幸東都，至華陰，上制嶽廟文，勒之於石，立於祠南之道周。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on gengshen, he went to the eastern capital; at Huayin he composed a text for the mountain temple, had it carved in stone, and set it up along the road south of the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he traveled east; at Huayin he carved his hymn to the sacred peak and set it beside the temple road.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，至自東都。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he returned from the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he came back from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，司徒、申王捴薨，追謚曰惠莊太子。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Prince of Shen, Grand Mentor, died; posthumously he was titled Crown Prince Hui Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Prince of Shen died and was mourned as Crown Prince Hui Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 五溪首領覃行璋反，遣鎮軍大將軍兼內侍楊思勖討平之。

translations.literal: Qin Xingzhang, chieftain of the Five Streams, rebelled; General of Garrisoned Armies and Palace Attendant Yang Sixu was sent to crush him.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Streams rose under Qin Xingzhang; Yang Sixu marched in and broke them.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月丙辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month, on bingchen the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the intercalary year’s end the new moon was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 開元十三年十三年春正月乙酉，以幽州都督府為大都督府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 13, in spring, the first month, on yiyou, the Youzhou area command was made a great area command.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan 13, on yiyou, Youzhou became a great area command.

sentences.zh: 戊子，降死罪從流，流已下罪悉原之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, death sentences were commuted to exile; all crimes below exile were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi capital convicts were sent into exile; lesser sentences were wiped clean.

sentences.zh: 分遣御史中丞蔣欽緒等往十道疏決囚徒。

translations.literal: Assistant Censor-in-Chief Jiang Qinxu and others were separately dispatched to the ten circuits to review and decide prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Qinxu and fellow censors fanned out across ten circuits to judge the prisons.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，幸龍門，即日還宮。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuwu, he visited Longmen and returned the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he made a day trip to Longmen.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，初置彍騎，分隸十二司。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Elite Cavalry was first established, divided among the twelve guards.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Elite Cavalry corps was founded under the twelve guard offices.

sentences.zh: 丙子，改豳州為邠州，鄚州為莫州，梁州為褒州，沅州為巫州，舞州為鶴州，泉州為福州，以避文相類及聲相近者。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the prefecture Bin (豳) was changed to Bin (邠), Mei to Mo, Liang to Bao, Yuan to Wu, Wu to He, and Quan to Fu—to avoid graphs resembling wen in writing or homophones in speech.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi six prefectures were renamed to dodge characters and sounds that clashed with the emperor’s name.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，皇太子嗣謙改名鴻；

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiawu, the crown prince Sizhi changed his name to Hong;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the crown prince Sizhi took the name Hong;

sentences.zh: 郯王嗣直改名潭，徙封慶王；

translations.literal: Prince of Tan Sizhi changed his name to Tan and was enfeoffed Prince of Qing;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince of Tan became Tan, Prince of Qing;

sentences.zh: 陜王嗣升改名浚，徙封忠王；

translations.literal: Prince of Shan Sisheng changed his name to Jun and was enfeoffed Prince of Zhong;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince of Shan became Jun, Prince of Zhong;

sentences.zh: 鄫王嗣真改名洽，徙封棣王；

translations.literal: Prince of Zeng Sizhen changed his name to Qia and was enfeoffed Prince of Di;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince of Zeng became Qia, Prince of Di;

sentences.zh: 鄂王嗣初改名涓，徙封郎王；

translations.literal: Prince of E Sichu changed his name to Juan and was enfeoffed Prince of Lang;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince of E became Juan, Prince of Lang;

sentences.zh: 嗣玄改名滉，封榮王。

translations.literal: Sixuan changed his name to Huang and was enfeoffed Prince of Rong.
translations.idiomatic: and Sixuan became Huang, Prince of Rong.

sentences.zh: 又第八子涺封為光王，第十二男濰封為儀王，第十三男沄封為潁王，第十六男澤封為永王，第十八男清封為壽王，第二十男洄封為延王，第二十一男沐封為盛王，第二十二男溢封為濟王。

translations.literal: The eighth son Ti was enfeoffed Prince of Guang; the twelfth son Wei Prince of Yi; the thirteenth Yun Prince of Ying; the sixteenth Ze Prince of Yong; the eighteenth Qing Prince of Shou; the twentieth Hui Prince of Yan; the twenty-first Mu Prince of Sheng; the twenty-second Yi Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Younger sons received fiefs: Ti as Guang, Wei as Yi, Yun as Ying, Ze as Yong, Qing as Shou, Hui as Yan, Mu as Sheng, Yi as Ji.

sentences.zh: 丙申，御史大夫程行諶奏：「周朝酷吏來子珣、萬國俊、王弘義、侯思止、郭霸、焦仁亶、張知默、李敬仁、唐奉一、來俊臣、周興、丘神勣、索元禮、曹仁哲、王景昭、裴籍、李秦授、劉光業、王德壽、屈貞筠、鮑思恭、劉景陽、王處貞等二十三人，殘害宗枝，毒陷良善，情狀尤重，子孫不許仕宦。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Censor-in-Chief Cheng Hangqian memorialized: “The Zhou persecutors Lai Zixun, Wan Guojun, Wang Hongyi, Hou Sizhi, Guo Ba, Jiao Renchan, Zhang Zhim, Li Jingren, Tang Fengyi, Lai Junyi, Zhou Xing, Qiu Shenji, Suo Yuanli, Cao Renzhe, Wang Jingzhao, Pei Ji, Li Qinshou, Liu Guangye, Wang Deshou, Qu Zhenyun, Bao Sigong, Liu Jingyang, Wang Chuzhen—twenty-three men—mutilated the imperial clan and framed the innocent in the gravest cases; their descendants shall not hold office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Cheng Hangqian named twenty-three Zhou torturers—from Lai Junyi and Zhou Xing to Wang Chuzhen—and barred their descendants forever from office.

sentences.zh: 陳嘉言、魚承曄、皇甫文備、傅游藝四人，情狀雖輕，子孫不許近任。

translations.literal: Chen Jiayan, Yu Chengye, Huangfu Wenbei, and Fu Youyi, though their guilt was lighter, shall have no descendant appointed to posts nearby.
translations.idiomatic: Four lesser offenders—Chen Jiayan, Yu Chengye, Huangfu Wenbei, Fu Youyi—were barred from near appointments for their kin as well.

sentences.zh: 請依開元二年二月五日敕。

translations.literal: We ask that the edict of the fifth day of the second month of Kaiyuan 2 be followed.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial asked that Kaiyuan 2 policy apply.

translations.literal: ” — end of the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: [Close of memorial.]

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，改集仙殿為集賢殿，麗正殿書院改集賢殿書院；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dingsi, the Hall of Collected Immortals was changed to the Hall of Gathered Worthies, and the Lizheng Hall Academy to the Gathered Worthies Academy;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Hall of Collected Immortals became the Hall of Gathered Worthies, its academy renamed likewise;

sentences.zh: 內五品已上為學士，六品已下為直學士。

translations.literal: those of fifth rank and above within the palace were made academicians; sixth rank and below, direct academicians.
translations.idiomatic: palace officers of fifth rank up became academicians, sixth rank down direct academicians.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，令朝集使各舉所部孝悌文武，集於泰山之下。

translations.literal: On guiyou, assembly envoys were ordered each to recommend filial, fraternal, civil, and martial men of their circuits to gather below Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou circuit envoys were told to send the worthy to assemble at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，妖賊劉定高率其黨夜犯通洛門，盡擒斬之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin, the sorcerer Liu Dinggao led his band in a night attack on the Tongluo Gate; all were seized and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the sorcerer Liu Dinggao stormed Tongluo Gate by night; his band was caught and killed.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，廢都西市。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yihai, the western market of the capital was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the capital’s western market was shut.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，新造銅儀成，置於景運門內，以示百官。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guichou, the new bronze armillary was completed and set inside the Jingyun Gate to be shown to the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month a new bronze armillary sphere was finished and displayed inside Jingyun Gate.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，東封泰山，發自東都。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the eastern tour to perform the Feng and Shan rites on Mount Tai set out from the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court set out from Luoyang to seal Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，至兗州岱宗頓。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingxu, they reached the Dai Temple halt at Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they reached the sacred halt at Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，致齋於行宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai, they fasted in the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor fasted in the travel palace.

sentences.zh: 己丑，日南至，備法駕登山，仗衛羅列嶽下百餘里。

translations.literal: On jichou, the winter solstice, the full imperial train climbed the mountain; guards and insignia lined the foothills for more than a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: On the solstice the imperial procession climbed Tai; armor glittered a hundred li below.

sentences.zh: 詔行從留於谷口，上與宰臣、禮官升山。

translations.literal: An edict kept the followers at the valley mouth; the emperor ascended with chief ministers and ritual officers.
translations.idiomatic: The train waited in the valley while the emperor went up with his ministers and masters of rites.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，祀昊天上帝於上壇，有司祀五帝百神於下壇。

translations.literal: On gengyin, he sacrificed to August Heaven on the upper altar; the relevant offices sacrificed to the Five Emperors and the hundred spirits on the lower altar.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he offered to Heaven on the summit altar; officers tended the lower altar to the Five Emperors and all spirits.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，藏玉冊於封祀壇之石䃭，然後燔柴。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, the jade register was placed in the stone casque of the altar of the seal; then the firewood was lit.
translations.idiomatic: The rite ended with the jade book sealed in stone; then the offering fire was kindled.

sentences.zh: 燎發，群臣稱萬歲，傳呼自山頂至嶽下，震動山谷。

translations.literal: As the flames rose, the ministers cried “Ten thousand years!”; the shout rolled from the peak to the foothills and shook the valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Flames climbed and a hundred voices shouted “Ten thousand years!” from peak to foothill until the mountains rang.

sentences.zh: 上還齋宮，慶雲見，日抱戴。

translations.literal: The emperor returned to the fasting palace; auspicious clouds appeared, and the sun wore a halo.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the fasting palace, lucky clouds gathered and a halo crowned the sun.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀皇地祇於社首，藏玉冊於石䃭，如封祀壇之禮。

translations.literal: On xinmao, he sacrificed to Earth at Sheshou, placed the jade register in the stone casque, and followed the rites of the seal altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he worshipped Earth at Sheshou, sealed the jade book in stone as on the summit.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，御帳殿受朝賀，大赦天下，流人未還者放還。

translations.literal: On renchen, in the tent hall he received congratulations; a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven, and exiles not yet home were sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he took homage in the tent hall, amnestied the realm, and called exiles home.

sentences.zh: 內外官三品已上賜爵一等，四品已下賜一階，登山官封賜一階，褒聖侯量才與處分。

translations.literal: Inner and outer officials of third rank and above received one noble rank; fourth rank and below one promotion; officers who climbed the mountain one further rank; the Marquis Who Exalts the Sage was given office according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officers gained a noble grade, fourth-rank men a step, mountaineers an extra rank; Confucius’ marquis was employed by merit.

sentences.zh: 封泰山神為天齊王，禮秩加三公一等，近山十里，禁其樵採。

translations.literal: The spirit of Mount Tai was enfeoffed as King Equalizing Heaven, with ritual rank one grade above the Three Excellencies; within ten li of the mountain, fuel-cutting was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Tai’s god became King Equalizing Heaven, honored above the Three Excellencies; for ten li around the peak, axes were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 賜酺七日。

translations.literal: The realm enjoyed great feasting for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Seven days of public feasting followed.

sentences.zh: 侍中源乾曜為尚書左丞相兼侍中，中書令張說為尚書右丞相兼中書令。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Yuan Qianyao was made Left Director of the Department of State Affairs and still Palace Attendant; Director of the Secretariat Zhang Yue was made Right Director and still Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Qianyao became Left Director while keeping his palace post; Zhang Yue became Right Director and kept the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甲午，發岱嶽。

translations.literal: On jiawu, they set out from Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the procession left Dai.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸孔子宅，親設奠祭。

translations.literal: On bingshen, he visited Confucius’ house and personally set out the offering.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he entered Confucius’ dwelling and sacrificed with his own hands.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，至東都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jisi, they reached the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the tour returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 時累歲豐稔，東都米斗十錢，青、齊米斗五錢。

translations.literal: For years harvests had been rich; in the eastern capital rice was ten cash the peck, in Qing and Qi five.
translations.idiomatic: Grain was cheap after years of plenty—ten cash a peck in Luoyang, five in the east.

sentences.zh: 是冬，分吏部為十銓，敕禮部尚書蘇頲、刑部尚書韋抗、工部尚書戶從願等分掌選事。

translations.literal: That winter the Personnel ministry was divided into ten selection boards; Ministers of Rites Su Ting, of Justice Wei Kang, and of Works Hu Congyuan and others were ordered each to take a share of appointments.
translations.idiomatic: That winter appointments were split among ten boards headed by Su Ting, Wei Kang, Hu Congyuan, and other ministers.

sentences.zh: 開元十四年十四年春正月癸亥，改封契丹松漠郡王李召固為廣化王，奚饒樂郡王李魯蘇為奉誠王，封宗室外甥女二人為公主，各以妻之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 14, in spring, the first month, on guihai, the Khitan Prince of Songmo Li Zhaogu was changed to Prince of Broad Transformation, the Xi Prince of Raole Li Lusu to Prince of Upholding Sincerity; two daughters of the imperial clan by marriage were made princesses and given to them in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan 14 the Khitan and Xi kings were re-titled and given imperial brides.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌朔，邕州獠首領梁大海、周光等據賓、橫等州叛，遣驃騎大將軍兼內侍楊思勖討之。

translations.literal: On gengxu the new moon, the Liao chieftains Liang Dahai and Zhou Guang seized Bin and Heng and rebelled; General of Agile Cavalry and Palace Attendant Yang Sixu was sent against them.
translations.idiomatic: At month’s start Liao rebels seized Bin and Heng; Yang Sixu marched south.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，以國甥東華公主降於契丹李召固。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renyin, the emperor’s niece the Eastern Splendor Princess was married to the Khitan Li Zhaogu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Eastern Splendor Princess was sent to Li Zhaogu of the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，御史中丞宇文融與御史大夫崔隱甫彈尚書右丞相、兼中書令張說，鞫於尚書省。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guichou, Assistant Censor-in-Chief Yuwen Rong and Censor-in-Chief Cui Yinpu impeached Right Director and Director of the Secretariat Zhang Yue; he was tried at the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Yuwen Rong and Cui Yinpu impeached Zhang Yue; the Secretariat chief stood trial.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，戶部侍郎李元紘同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Vice Minister of Revenue Li Yuanhong was made co-signer of Secretariat-Chancellery documents.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Yuanhong joined the inner council.

sentences.zh: 庚申，張說停兼中書令。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Zhang Yue ceased serving as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhang Yue was stripped of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太子少師、岐王範薨，冊贈惠文太子。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the Prince of Qi, Junior Tutor of the Heir, died; he was posthumously titled Crown Prince Hui Wen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Prince of Qi died and was mourned as Crown Prince Hui Wen.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，於定、恆、莫、易、滄等五州置軍以備突厥。

translations.literal: On xinchou, military commands were established in Ding, Heng, Mo, Yi, and Cang to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou five Hebei prefectures were garrisoned against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，戶部進計帳，今年管戶七百六萬九千五百六十五，管口四千一百四十一萬九千七百一十二。

translations.literal: On guimao the Household ministry presented the census: registered households 7,069,565; registered persons 41,419,712.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the census reported more than seven million households and forty-one million souls.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，大風，拔木發屋，毀端門鴟吻，都城門等及寺觀鴟吻落者殆半。

translations.literal: On wuwu a great wind uprooted trees and tore off roofs; the owl finials of the Endless Gate and half the finials on city gates and temples fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu a gale uprooted trees, stripped roofs, and knocked half the palace and city finials to earth.

sentences.zh: 上以旱、暴風雨，命中外群官上封事，指言時政得失，無有所隱。

translations.literal: Because of drought and violent storms, the emperor ordered inner and outer officials to submit sealed memorials frankly stating gains and losses in current policy, concealing nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Drought and storms moved him to demand sealed memorials on policy without fear or flattery.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑夜，瀍水暴漲入漕，漂沒諸州租船數百艘，溺者甚眾。

translations.literal: On the night of guichou in the seventh month, the Chan River surged into the canal and sank several hundred grain barges from the circuits; many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: One night in the seventh month the Chan burst into the canal and drowned hundreds of tax barges.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，檢校黃門侍郎兼磧西副大都護杜暹同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On jichou, Acting Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and Acting Vice Protector-General of the Western Regions Du Xian was made co-signer of Secretariat-Chancellery documents.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Du Xian of the Western Regions joined the inner council.

sentences.zh: 是秋，十五州言旱及霜，五十州言水，河南、河北尤甚，蘇、同、常、福四州漂壞廬舍，遣御史中丞宇文融檢覆賑給之。

translations.literal: That autumn, fifteen circuits reported drought and frost; fifty reported flood; Henan and Hebei suffered worst; in Su, Tong, Chang, and Fu prefectures houses were washed away—Assistant Censor-in-Chief Yuwen Rong was sent to inspect and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn brought drought, frost, and floods across the north; Yuwen Rong went out to survey and feed the ruined.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，廢麟州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Lin Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Lin prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸汝州廣成湯。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he visited the Broad Completion baths at Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he went to the Broad Completion hot springs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，還東都。

translations.literal: On jisi, he returned to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，突厥遣使來朝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, the Turks sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Turkish envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，渤海靺鞨遣其子義信來朝，並獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Mohe of Bohai sent the heir’s son Yixin to court with tribute of local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Bohai’s heir sent his son Yixin with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，幸壽安之方秀川。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, he visited the Square Excellence River in Shou’an.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he hunted at Square Excellence River in Shou’an.

sentences.zh: 己未，日色赤如赭。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the sun’s color was red as ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the sun burned ochre-red.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，還東都。

translations.literal: On renxu, he returned to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he came back to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 開元十五年十五年春正月戊寅，制草澤有文武高才，令詣闕自舉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 15, in spring, the first month, on wuyin, an edict invited men of talent, civil or martial, from common life to present themselves at court.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan 15 an edict called hidden worthies of every kind to court.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太史監復為太史局，依舊隸秘書省。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Astrological Directorate was again made the Astrological Bureau, subordinate to the Secretariat as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Astrological Directorate again became a bureau under the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，涼州都督王君㚟破吐蕃於青海之西，虜輜車、馬羊而還。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Protector-General of Liangzhou Wang Junchuo defeated the Tibetans west of Qinghai and returned with wagons, horses, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wang Junchuo routed Tibetans west of Qinghai and drove home their herds.

sentences.zh: 二月，遣左監門將軍黎敬仁往河北賑給貧乏，時河北牛畜大疫。

translations.literal: In the second month, Left Gate General Li Jingren was sent to Hebei to relieve the poor; cattle pestilence was severe in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Li Jingren carried grain to plague-stricken Hebei.

sentences.zh: 己巳，尚書右丞相張說、御史大夫崔隱甫、中丞宇文融以朋黨相構，制說致仕，隱甫免官侍母，融左遷魏州刺史。

translations.literal: On jisi, Right Director Zhang Yue, Censor-in-Chief Cui Yinpu, and Assistant Censor-in-Chief Yuwen Rong were judged to have formed factions against one another; Zhang Yue was ordered to retire, Cui Yinpu dismissed to serve his mother, and Yuwen Rong demoted to Weizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi faction fighting toppled Zhang Yue into retirement, sent Cui Yinpu home to his mother, and banished Yuwen Rong to Wei.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，晉州大水，漂損居人廬舍。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Jin Prefecture suffered great flood, washing away dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Jin was flooded and houses swept away.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以慶王潭為涼州都督兼河西諸軍節度大使，忠王浚為單于大都護、朔方節度大使，棣王洽為太原冀北牧、河北諸軍節度大使，鄂王涓為幽州都督、河北節度大使，榮王滉為京兆牧、隴右節度大使，光王涺為廣州都督、五府節度大使，儀王濰為河南牧，潁王潭為安東都護、平盧軍節度大使，永王澤為荊州大都督，壽王清為益州大都督、劍南節度大使，延王洄為安西大都護、磧西節度大使，盛王沐為揚州大都督，並不出閣。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Prince of Qing Tan was made Liangzhou governor and commander of Hexi armies; Prince of Zhong Jun was made Protector-General of the Shanyu and Shuofang commissioner; Prince of Di Qia was made Taiyuan and Jibei herdsman and Hebei army commissioner; Prince of E Juan was Youzhou governor and Hebei commissioner; Prince of Rong Huang was Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao and Longyou commissioner; Prince of Guang Ti was Guangzhou governor and commissioner of the Five Offices; Prince of Yi Wei was Henan herdsman; Prince of Ying Tan was Protector-General of Andong and Pinglu commissioner; Prince of Yong Ze was Governor-General of Jingzhou; Prince of Shou Qing was Governor-General of Yizhou and Sword South commissioner; Prince of Yan Hui was Protector-General of Anxi and Western Regions commissioner; Prince of Sheng Mu was Governor-General of Yangzhou—all without leaving the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou each prince received a titular frontier command—Qing, Zhong, Di, E, Rong, Guang, Yi, Ying, Yong, Shou, Yan, and Sheng—yet none left the palace.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，雷震興教門樓兩鴟吻，欄檻及柱災。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu, lightning struck the two owl finials of the Gate of Promoting Teaching; the balustrades and pillars burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month lightning shattered the finials of the Gate of Promoting Teaching and set its columns afire.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書蘇頲卒。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Su Ting died.
translations.idiomatic: Su Ting, Minister of Rites, died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，鄜州洛水泛漲，壞人廬舍。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Luo River at Fuzhou overflowed and destroyed people’s dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Luo at Fu burst its banks and washed away homes.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，又壞同州馮翊縣廨宇，及溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: On xinmao, it again destroyed the government offices of Fengyi County in Tong Prefecture; many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the flood wrecked Fengyi’s yamen in Tong and drowned a great many.

sentences.zh: 丙申，改武臨縣為潁陽縣。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Wulin County was changed to Yingyang County.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wulin county was renamed Yingyang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，赦都城系囚，死罪降從流，徒已下罪悉免之。

translations.literal: On jihai, prisoners in the capital were pardoned: death was commuted to exile, and all crimes below exile were forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai capital prisoners were freed—death to exile, lesser crimes wiped clean.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，吐蕃寇瓜州，執刺史田元獻及王君㚟父壽，殺掠人吏，盡取軍資倉糧而去。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the ninth month, the Tibetans raided Guazhou, seized Governor Tian Yuanxian and Wang Junchuo’s father Shou, killed and plundered officials and clerks, and carried off all military stores and granary grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Tibetans took Guazhou, captured Tian Yuanxian and Wang Junchuo’s father, and stripped the garrison bare.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，突厥毗伽可汗使其大臣梅錄啜來朝。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Türk Bilge Qaghan sent his minister Melüchuo to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Bilge Qaghan of the Turks sent Minister Melüchuo to court.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚子，突騎施蘇祿、吐蕃贊普圍安西，副大都護趙頤貞擊走之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengzi, the Turgesh Sulu and the Tibetan king besieged Anxi; Vice Protector-General Zhao Yizhen drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Sulu of the Turgesh and the Tibetan king besieged Anxi; Zhao Yizhen beat them back.

sentences.zh: 庚申，車駕發東都，還京師。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the imperial carriage set out from the eastern capital and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court left Luoyang for Chang’an.

sentences.zh: 回紇部落殺王君㚟於甘州之鞏筆驛。

translations.literal: The Uyghur tribe killed Wang Junchuo at the Gongbi post in Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Uyghurs murdered Wang Junchuo at the Gongbi post in Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 制檢校兵部尚書蕭嵩兼判涼州事，總兵以御吐蕃。

translations.literal: An edict made Acting Minister of War Xiao Song also judge Liangzhou affairs and command troops to resist the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Song was ordered to govern Liangzhou and hold the frontier against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 是秋，六十三州水，十七州霜旱；

translations.literal: That autumn, sixty-three circuits reported flood; seventeen reported frost and drought;
translations.idiomatic: That autumn sixty-three circuits flooded and seventeen knew frost and drought;

sentences.zh: 河北饑，轉江淮之南租米百萬石以賑給之。

translations.literal: Hebei suffered famine; a million shi of southern grain tax was transferred from the Huai and Yang region to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: starving Hebei was fed with a million shi of grain shipped up from the south.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，至自東都。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao, he returned from the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he entered Chang’an from the east.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yihai, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he went to the Hot Springs.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he came back from the springs.

sentences.zh: 開元十六年十六年春正月庚子，始聽政於興慶宮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 16, in spring, the first month, on gengzi, he first held court at Xingqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan 16 he began to rule from Xingqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 春、瀧等州獠首領瀧州刺史陳行範、廣州首領馮仁智、何游魯叛，遣驃騎大將軍楊思勖討之。

translations.literal: In spring, the Liao chieftains of Chun and Long—Liao Prefecture governor Chen Xingfan, Guangzhou chieftain Feng Renzhi, and He Youlu—rebelled; General of Agile Cavalry Yang Sixu was sent to crush them.
translations.idiomatic: Liao rebels rose in Chun and Long; Yang Sixu marched against Chen Xingfan, Feng Renzhi, and He Youlu.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，安西副大都護趙頤貞敗吐蕃於曲子城。

translations.literal: On renyin, Vice Protector-General of Anxi Zhao Yizhen defeated the Tibetans at Quzi City.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhao Yizhen routed Tibetans at Quzi City.

sentences.zh: 甲子，黑水靺鞨遣使來朝獻。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Mohe of Heishui sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Heishui Mohe brought tribute to court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，吐蕃寇瓜州，刺史張守珪擊破之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Tibetans raided Guazhou; Governor Zhang Shougui defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Tibetans raided Guazhou; Zhang Shougui drove them off.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，檢校兵部尚書蕭嵩、鄯州都督張志亮攻拔吐蕃門城，斬獲數千級，收其資畜而還。

translations.literal: On yisi, Acting Minister of War Xiao Song and Zhengzhou Protector Zhang Zhiliang stormed and took the Tibetan border fort, beheading and capturing several thousand and seizing livestock.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Xiao Song and Zhang Zhiliang stormed a Tibetan fort, taking thousands of heads and herds.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，新羅王金興光遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On bingchen, King Geumseong of Silla sent envoys with local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Silla’s king sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，特進張說進《開元大衍歷》，詔命有司頒行之。

translations.literal: On jisi of the eighth month, Special Advance Zhang Yue presented the Kaiyuan Great Circumference Calendar; an edict ordered the relevant offices to promulgate it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhang Yue presented the Kaiyuan calendar and the court ordered it spread.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，蕭嵩又遣杜賓客擊吐蕃於祁連城，大破之，獲其大將一人，斬首五千級。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Xiao Song again sent Du Binke to strike the Tibetans at Qilian City, routing them greatly, capturing one of their great generals, and beheading five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Du Binke shattered Tibetans at Qilian City and took a general’s head among five thousand.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，以久雨，降死罪從流，徒以下原之。

translations.literal: On bingwu of the ninth month, because of long rain, death sentences were commuted to exile and all crimes below exile were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month endless rain brought amnesty—death to exile, lesser crimes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he went to the Hot Springs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On jichou, he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he returned from the springs.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳朔，檢校兵部尚書、河西節度判涼州事蕭嵩為兵部尚書、同中書門下平章事，餘如故。

translations.literal: On guisi the new moon, Acting Minister of War and Hexi commissioner judging Liangzhou Xiao Song was made Minister of War and co-signer of Secretariat-Chancellery documents, his other posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: At month’s start Xiao Song of the Hexi frontier joined the inner council as War minister.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he again went to the Hot Springs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On dingchou, he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he came back from the springs.

sentences.zh: 開元十七年十七年二月丁卯，巂州都督張審素攻破蠻，拔昆明城及鹽城，殺獲萬人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 17, in the second month, on dingmao, Protector-General of Xizhou Zhang Shensu defeated the barbarians, stormed Kunming City and Salt City, and killed or captured ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan 17 Zhang Shensu stormed Kunming and Salt cities and took ten thousand lives.

sentences.zh: 庚子，特進張說復為尚書左丞相，同州刺史陸象先為太子少保。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Special Advance Zhang Yue was again made Left Director of the Department of State Affairs; Tongzhou governor Lu Xiangxian was made Junior Tutor of the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhang Yue returned as Left Director; Lu Xiangxian became the heir’s tutor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，禮部尚書、信安王禕帥眾攻拔吐蕃石堡城。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Minister of Rites and Prince of Xin’an Yi led the host in storming and taking the Tibetan Stone Fortress City.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Prince of Xin’an Yi stormed and took the Tibetan Stone Fortress.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，令中書門下分就大理、京兆、萬年、長安等獄疏決囚徒。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guihai, an edict ordered the Secretariat and Chancellery each to go in turn to the courts of the Grand Court, Jingzhao, Wannian, and Chang’an to review and decide prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the inner council was sent to judge prisoners in the capital courts.

sentences.zh: 制天下系囚死罪減一等，餘並宥之。

translations.literal: An edict reduced death by one grade for prisoners throughout the realm and pardoned the rest.
translations.idiomatic: An edict lightened capital sentences one grade and freed the rest.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大風震電，藍田山崩。

translations.literal: On dinghai, great wind, thunder, and lightning; Mount Lantian collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai thunder shook the sky and Mount Lantian fell.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，復置十道按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guisi, the ten-circuit investigating commissioners were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the ten-circuit investigating commissioners returned.

sentences.zh: 右散騎常侍徐堅卒。

translations.literal: Right Regular Attendant Xu Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jian, Right Regular Attendant, died.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，尚書左丞相源乾曜停兼侍中，黃門侍郎杜暹為荊州大都督府長史，中書侍郎李元紘為曹州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Left Director Yuan Qianyao ceased serving as Palace Attendant; Vice Director of the Yellow Gate Du Xian was made chief administrator of Jingzhou; Vice Director of the Secretariat Li Yuanhong was made Caozhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yuan Qianyao left the palace post; Du Xian went to Jing; Li Yuanhong to Cao.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書蕭嵩兼中書令。

translations.literal: Minister of War Xiao Song was also made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Song added the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎兼鴻臚卿宇文融為黃門侍郎，兵部侍郎裴光庭為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。
