translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Master of the Court for Diplomatic Reception Yuwen Rong was made Vice Director of the Yellow Gate; Vice Minister of War Pei Guangting was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; both were co-signers of Secretariat-Chancellery documents.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Rong and Pei Guangting joined the inner council from Revenue and War.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，工部尚書張嘉貞卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on xinchou, Minister of Works Zhang Jiazhen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Zhang Jiazhen died.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，上以降誕日，宴百僚於花萼樓下。

translations.literal: On guihai of the eighth month, because it was the day of his birth, he feasted the hundred officials below the Tower of Flower and Calyx.
translations.idiomatic: On his birthday in the eighth month he feasted the court below the Tower of Flower and Calyx.

sentences.zh: 百僚表請以每年八月五日為千秋節，王公已下獻鏡及承露囊，天下諸州咸令宴樂，休暇三日，仍編為令，從之。

translations.literal: The hundred officials memorialized that every year on the fifth day of the eighth month should be the Thousand Autumn Festival: princes and dukes down should present mirrors and dew-collecting pouches; all prefectures should hold feasts and music, with three days’ rest; it was codified as statute, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court made his birthday the Thousand Autumn Festival—mirrors and dew-pouches, feasts empire-wide, three days’ rest—written into law.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，越州大水，漂壞廨宇及居人廬舍。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Yue Prefecture suffered great flood, washing away government offices and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin a flood wrecked Yue’s offices and homes.

sentences.zh: 己卯，中書侍郎裴光庭兼御史大夫，依舊知政事。

translations.literal: On jimao, Vice Director of the Secretariat Pei Guangting was also made Censor-in-Chief, still managing government as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Pei Guangting took the censorate while keeping his council seat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，尚書右丞相、開府儀同三司兼吏部尚書宋璟為尚書左丞相，尚書左丞相源乾曜為太子少傅。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Right Director and Palace Grandee of the First Rank and Minister of Personnel Song Jing was made Left Director; Left Director Yuan Qianyao was made Junior Tutor of the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Song Jing became Left Director; Yuan Qianyao tutored the heir.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，宇文融左遷汝州刺史，俄又貶昭州平樂尉。

translations.literal: On renzi of the ninth month, Yuwen Rong was demoted to Ruzhou governor; soon after he was further demoted to Pingle county captain in Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yuwen Rong was banished to Ru, then to a Zhaozhou captaincy.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，裴光庭為黃門侍郎，依舊知政事。

translations.literal: On renyin, Pei Guangting was made Vice Director of the Yellow Gate, still managing government as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Pei Guangting moved to the Yellow Gate and kept his council seat.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午朔，日有蝕之，不盡如鉤。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu the new moon, there was a partial solar eclipse shaped like a hook.
translations.idiomatic: At the tenth month’s new moon the sun was eaten to a hook.

sentences.zh: 癸未，睦州獻竹實。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Mu Prefecture presented bamboo grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Mu presented bamboo grain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，前太子賓客元行沖卒。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the former Guest of the Heir Yuan Xingchong died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Yuan Xingchong, former guest of the heir, died.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，親饗九廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, he personally feasted the nine temples.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he sacrificed to the nine temples.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，發京師。

translations.literal: On xinmao, he set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he left Chang’an.

sentences.zh: 丙申，謁橋陵。

translations.literal: On bingchen, he visited Qiao Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he worshipped at Qiao Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 上望陵涕泣、左右並哀感。

translations.literal: Gazing at the tomb he wept; those left and right were all moved to grief.
translations.idiomatic: He wept before the tomb until every attendant wept with him.

sentences.zh: 制奉先縣同赤縣，以所管萬三百戶供陵寢，三府兵馬供宿衛，曲赦縣內大闢罪已下。

translations.literal: An edict made Fengxian County equal to Chixian; its ten thousand three hundred households were assigned to maintain the mausoleum; the three metropolitan guards supplied night watch; the county within was given a partial amnesty for capital crimes and below.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxian was raised to capital rank, given households and guards for Gaozu’s tomb, and partially amnestied.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，謁定陵。

translations.literal: On wuxu, he visited Ding Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he visited Ding Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 己亥，謁獻陵。

translations.literal: On jihai, he visited Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he visited Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，謁昭陵。

translations.literal: On renyin, he visited Zhao Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he visited Zhao Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，謁乾陵。

translations.literal: On yisi, he visited Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he visited Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 戊申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On wushen, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the tour returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，流移人並放還，左降官移近處。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven; exiles were sent home; demoted officials were moved nearer.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was amnestied, exiles called home, and banished officers brought closer.

sentences.zh: 百姓無出今年地稅之半。

translations.literal: The common people were exempted from half this year’s land tax.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax was cut by half for the year.

sentences.zh: 每陵取側近六鄉供陵寢。

translations.literal: For each mausoleum six neighboring townships were taken to maintain the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Six townships by each tomb were charged with upkeep.

sentences.zh: 內外官三品巳上加爵一等，四品已下賜一階，五品已上清官父母亡者，依級賜官及邑號。

translations.literal: Inner and outer officials of third rank and above received one noble rank; fourth rank and below one promotion; for fifth rank and above pure officials whose parents had died, offices and fief titles were granted by grade.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officers gained a noble grade, fourth-rank men a step; pure officers mourning parents received posthumous honors by rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he went to the Hot Springs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，校獵渭濱。

translations.literal: On yichou, he hunted along the Wei ford.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he hunted along the Wei.

sentences.zh: 壬申，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On renshen, he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he came back from the springs.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no snow fell.

sentences.zh: 開元十八年十八年春正月辛卯，黃門侍郎裴光庭為侍中，依舊兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 18, in spring, the first month, on xinmao, Vice Director of the Yellow Gate Pei Guangting was made Palace Attendant, still also Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan 18 Pei Guangting became Palace Attendant while keeping the censorate.

sentences.zh: 左丞相張說加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Left Director Zhang Yue was given the Palace Grandee of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue received the first-rank grandee title.

sentences.zh: 丙午，幸薛王業宅，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On bingwu, he visited Prince Ye’s residence and returned the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he called on Prince Ye and returned the same day.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，大雨雪，俄而雷震，左飛龍廄災。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingyin, heavy snow fell, then thunder; the Left Flying Dragon stable burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month snow gave way to thunder and fire consumed the Left Flying Dragon stable.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，改定州縣上中下戶口之數，依舊給京官職田。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinmao, the upper, middle, and lower household quotas of Ding Prefecture’s counties were revised, and official fields for capital officers were granted as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Ding’s household grades were reset and capital officers’ fields restored.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，築京城外郭城，凡十月而功畢。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yimao, the outer wall of the capital was built; the work was finished in ten months.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month work began on the capital’s outer wall and finished ten months later.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸寧親公主第，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On renxu, he visited Princess Ningqin’s residence and returned the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he visited Princess Ningqin and returned.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，裴光庭兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On yichou, Pei Guangting was also made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Pei Guangting took Personnel as well.

sentences.zh: 是春，命侍臣及百僚每旬暇日尋勝地宴樂，仍賜錢令所司供帳造食。

translations.literal: That spring, the emperor ordered attending ministers and the hundred officials on each ten-day rest day to seek scenic places for feasting and pleasure, and granted cash for the relevant offices to supply tents and prepare food.
translations.idiomatic: That spring the court was told to feast on every rest day, with cash for tents and cooks.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，侍臣已下宴於春明門外寧王憲之園池，上御花萼樓邀其回騎，便令坐飲，遞起為舞，頒賜有差。

translations.literal: On dingmao, ministers and below feasted in Prince of Ning Xian’s garden pool outside the Chunming Gate; the emperor from the Tower of Flower and Calyx met their returning riders, had them sit and drink, took turns dancing, and bestowed gifts in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the ministers feasted in Ning Wang’s garden; the emperor met them from Flower and Calyx Tower, made them drink and dance, and gave gifts.

sentences.zh: 五月，契丹衙官可突干殺其主李召固，率部落降於突厥，奚部落亦隨西叛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Khitan yabgu Ketugan killed his lord Li Zhaogu, led the tribe to surrender to the Turks, and the Xi tribes likewise rebelled westward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Khitan Ketugan slew Li Zhaogu and fled to the Turks; the Xi went west with him.

sentences.zh: 奚王李魯蘇來奔，召固妻東華公主陳氏及魯蘇妻東光公主韋氏並奔投平盧軍。

translations.literal: King Li Lusu of the Xi came in flight; Li Zhaogu’s wife Princess Eastern Splendor Chen and Li Lusu’s wife Princess Eastern Light Wei both fled to the Pinglu army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Lusu of the Xi fled in; the Khitan and Xi princesses took refuge with Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 制幽州長史趙含章率兵討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Youzhou chief administrator Zhao Hanzhang to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hanzhang of Youzhou was sent to punish them.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，命左右丞相、尚書及中書門下五品已上官，舉才堪邊任及刺史者。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengshen, an edict ordered the Left and Right Directors, ministers, and Secretariat-Chancellery officials of fifth rank and above to recommend men fit for frontier duty or for prefectural office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month fifth-rank ministers were told to recommend men for the frontier and for prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲子，彗星見於五車。

translations.literal: On jiazi, a comet appeared in the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi a comet hung in the Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，有星孛于畢、昴。

translations.literal: On guiyou, a broom star blazed in Net and Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou a broom star crossed Net and Mao.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命單于大都護、忠王浚為河北道行軍元帥，御史大夫李朝隱、京兆尹裴伷先為副，率十八總管以討契丹及奚等。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the Protector-General of the Shanyu and Prince of Zhong Jun was made commander-in-chief of the Hebei campaign, Censor-in-Chief Li Chaoyin and Metropolitan Governor Pei Youxian his deputies, to lead eighteen area commanders against the Khitan and Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Prince of Zhong Jun was named to lead eighteen commands against Khitan and Xi, with Li Chaoyin and Pei Youxian as deputies.

sentences.zh: 事竟不行。

translations.literal: The campaign in the end was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The expedition never marched.

sentences.zh: 壬午，東都瀍、洛泛漲，壞天津、永濟二橋及提象門外仗舍，損居人廬舍千餘家。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Chan and Luo rivers at the eastern capital overflowed, destroying the Tianjin and Yongji bridges and the guard barracks outside the Elephant Gate, and damaging more than a thousand dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu floods wrecked Luoyang’s great bridges and a thousand houses.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲申，分幽州置薊州。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiashen, Ji Prefecture was split off from Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Ji was carved from You.

sentences.zh: 已丑，令範安及、韓朝宗就瀍、洛水源疏決，置門以節水勢。

translations.literal: On jichou, Fan Anji and Han Chaozong were sent to dredge the sources of the Chan and Luo and set sluice gates to check the water.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Fan Anji and Han Chaozong dredged the Chan and Luo headwaters and set flood gates.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禮部奏請千秋節休假三日，及村閭社會，並就千秋節先賽白帝，報田祖，然後坐飲散之。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Ministry of Rites memorialized that the Thousand Autumn Festival should have three days’ leave, and that village community rites should on the festival first offer to the White Emperor and report to the field god, then sit, drink, and disperse.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Rites asked for three festival days and harvest rites tied to the Thousand Autumn observance.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，幸寧王憲第，即日還宮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on gengchen, he visited Prince of Ning Xian’s residence and returned the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he visited Ning Wang and returned.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，上御花萼樓，以千秋節百官獻賀，賜四品已上金鏡、珠囊、縑彩，賜五品已下束帛有差。

translations.literal: On dinghai of the eighth month, the emperor ascended the Tower of Flower and Calyx; on the Thousand Autumn Festival the hundred officials presented congratulations; fourth rank and above received gold mirrors, pearl pouches, and colored silk; fifth rank and below received bundled silk in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On his birthday he took Flower and Calyx Tower, received court homage, and gave mirrors, pearls, and silk by rank.

sentences.zh: 上賦八韻詩，又制《秋景詩》。

translations.literal: The emperor composed an eight-rhyme poem and also wrote Autumn Scenery.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote an eight-line poem and an Autumn Scenery piece.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸永穆公主宅，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he visited Princess Yongmu’s residence and returned the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he called on Princess Yongmu and returned.

sentences.zh: 九月，先是高戶捉官本錢；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, earlier wealthy households had advanced official principal at interest;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month wealthy households had been advancing tax principal at interest;

sentences.zh: 乙卯，御史大夫李朝隱奏請薄稅百姓一年租錢充，依舊高戶及典正等捉，隨月收利，供官人稅錢。

translations.literal: On yimao, Censor-in-Chief Li Chaoyin memorialized that one year’s land tax from the common people should lightly supply it, and as before wealthy households and stewards should collect it, taking monthly interest to pay officials’ tax money.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Li Chaoyin asked that one year’s rent fund the pool, with wealthy agents collecting monthly interest as before.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，吐蕃遣其大臣名悉獵獻方物，請降，許之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Tibet sent its minister Mingxishou with tribute and to request surrender; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Tibet sent the minister Mingxishou with gifts to offer submission; the court accepted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸岐州之鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: On gengyin he visited Fengquan Hot Springs in Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he went to Fengquan Hot Springs in Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，至自鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: On guimao he returned from Fengquan Hot Springs.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he came back from Fengquan Hot Springs.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，幸新豐溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on dingmao he visited the Hot Springs Palace at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, he visited the Xinfeng Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，豐州刺史袁振坐妖言下獄死。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on wuzi, Yuan Zhen, prefect of Fengzhou, died in prison on a charge of sorcery talk.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi, Fengzhou prefect Yuan Zhen was jailed and executed for sorcery.

sentences.zh: 戊申，尚書左丞相、燕國公張說薨。

translations.literal: On wushen, Left Chancellor of the Secretariat, Duke of Yan, Zhang Yue, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhang Yue, Left Chancellor and Duke of Yan, died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，百僚及華州父老累表請上尊號內請加「聖文」兩字，並封西嶽，不允。

translations.literal: That year officials and elders of Huazhou repeatedly memorialized for an honorific title adding the characters “Shengwen” and to ennoble Mount Hua; neither was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That year the bureaucracy and Huazhou elders repeatedly asked for a grand title with “Shengwen” and to invest Mount Hua; both were refused.

sentences.zh: 開元十九年十九年春正月壬戌，開府儀同三司、霍國公王毛仲貶為襄州別駕，中路賜死，黨與貶黜者十數人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 19, in spring, the first month, on renxu, Wang Maoqiong, Grand Guardian Equal in Rank, Duke of Huo, was demoted to Vice-Prefect of Xiangzhou and executed en route; a dozen associates were banished.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan 19, on renxu, Wang Maoqiong, Duke of Huo, was demoted to Xiangzhou and executed on the road; more than ten of his faction were exiled.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣鴻臚卿崔琳入吐蕃報聘。

translations.literal: On xinmao he sent Minister of Foreign Reception Cui Lin to Tibet on a return embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he dispatched Cui Lin, Minister of Foreign Reception, to Tibet on a return mission.

sentences.zh: 丙子，親耕於興慶宮龍池。

translations.literal: On bingzi he personally plowed at the Dragon Pool in Xingqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he plowed in person at the Dragon Pool in Xingqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，禁採捕鯉魚。

translations.literal: On jimao catching carp was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the taking of carp was banned.

sentences.zh: 天下州府春秋二時社及釋奠，停牲牢，唯用酒酺，永為常式。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm spring and autumn community sacrifices and Confucian libations were to omit livestock, using only libations of wine, in perpetual statute.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and autumn community rites and Confucian libations empire-wide were to drop livestock and use wine only, forever.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，以崔琳為御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the second month on jiawu Cui Lin was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiawu, Cui Lin became Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉朔，崔琳使於吐蕃。

translations.literal: On the yiyou new moon of the third month Cui Lin departed as envoy to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On the third-month yiyou new moon Cui Lin left for Tibet.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，於京城置禮院。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renwu, a Ritual Institute was established in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renwu, a Ritual Institute was set up in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，令兩京及天下諸州各置太公尚父廟，以張良配饗，春秋二時仲月上戊日祭之。

translations.literal: On bingshen orders went out that both capitals and all prefectures were to build temples to the Grand Duke and Lord Father, with Zhang Liang as associate sacrifice, worshipped on the upper wu days of the second and eighth months.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen both capitals and every prefecture were ordered to build a temple to Lord Father Jiang Ziya, with Zhang Liang in joint sacrifice on upper-wu days in the second and eighth months.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，五嶽各置老君廟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on renxu each of the Five Sacred Peaks received a temple to the Lord Lao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, each of the Five Peaks gained a temple to Lord Lao.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on yiyou a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou, a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛巳，降天下死罪從流，徒已下悉原之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on xinsi, capital crimes were commuted to exile and penal servitude and below were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, death sentences became exile and lesser penalties were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，吐蕃遣其國相論尚他硉來朝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on xinwei Tibet sent its chancellor Lun Shangtaluo on court visit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei, Tibet sent chancellor Lun Shangtaluo to court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，幸東都。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on bingshen he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingshen, he traveled to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，至自東都。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on bingchen he returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, he returned from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太子少傅源乾曜薨。

translations.literal: On jiazi Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Yuan Qianyao died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the heir’s grand tutor Yuan Qianyao died.

sentences.zh: 十二月，巂州都督張審素以劫制使監察御史楊汪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Zhang Shensu, area commander of Xizhou, was executed for having seized and coerced the censor Yang Wang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xizhou commander Zhang Shensu was executed for kidnapping and coercing censor Yang Wang.

sentences.zh: 是冬，浚苑內洛水，六十餘日而罷。

translations.literal: That winter the Luo River within the park was dredged; the work ceased after sixty-odd days.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Luo inside the park was dredged for sixty-odd days, then stopped.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，裴光庭上《瑤山往則》、《維城前軌》各一卷，上令賜太子、諸王各一本。

translations.literal: On wuxu Pei Guangting presented one scroll each of “Past Models from Jade Mountain” and “Former Tracks of the Wall-City”; the emperor ordered a copy given to the crown prince and each prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Pei Guangting offered Jade Mountain’s Past Models and the Wall-City’s Former Tracks, one scroll each; the throne gave copies to the heir and every prince.

sentences.zh: 開元二十年二十年春正月乙卯，以禮部尚書、信安王禕率兵討契丹。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 20, in spring, the first month, on yimao, Li Yi, Prince of Xin’an and Minister of Rites, was ordered to lead troops against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan 20, on yimao, Prince Xin’an Li Yi, Minister of Rites, was sent to campaign against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸長芬公主宅；

translations.literal: On dingsi he visited the mansion of Princess Changfen;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he called at Princess Changfen’s residence;

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸薛王業宅：並即日還宮。

translations.literal: On yichou he visited Prince Xue Ye’s mansion: both times he returned to the palace the same day.
translations.idiomatic: on yichou at Prince Xue Li Ye’s—each visit ended with a same-day return to the palace.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，敕文武選人，承前例三月三十日為例，然開選門，比團甲進官至夏來。

translations.literal: On jiwei an edict on civil-service selection: by former precedent the thirtieth day of the third month was the rule, yet the selection gates opened and the “group-A” promotions ran until summer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict fixed civil selection: the old rule had opened on the third month’s last day, with promotions dragging into summer.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，選門並正月內開，團甲二月內訖。

translations.literal: Henceforth the selection gates were to open within the first month, and group-A lists were to finish within the second.
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter gates opened in the first month and group-A lists closed in the second.

sentences.zh: 分命宰相錄京城諸獄系囚。

translations.literal: Chancellors were separately ordered to review prisoners held in the capital’s jails.
translations.idiomatic: Each chancellor was told to review capital prisoners.

sentences.zh: 三月，信安王禕與幽州長史趙含章大破奚、契丹於幽州之北山。

translations.literal: In the third month Prince Xin’an Li Yi and Youzhou chief administrator Zhao Hanzang routed the Xi and Khitan north of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Yi and Zhao Hanzang smashed the Xi and Khitan north of Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，宴百僚於上陽東州，醉者賜以床褥，肩輿而歸，相屬於路。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yihai, he feasted the hundred officials at Shangyang’s eastern islet; the drunk were given bedding and sedan chairs to ride home, one after another along the road.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the fourth month he feasted officials on Shangyang’s eastern islet; drunk guests got bedding and palanquins home in a line along the road.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，改造天津橋，毀皇津橋，合為一橋。

translations.literal: On guisi the Tianjin Bridge was rebuilt, the Huangjin Bridge destroyed, and the two joined into one bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Tianjin Bridge was rebuilt, Huangjin Bridge torn down, and the spans united.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，寒食上墓，宜編入五禮，永為恆式。

translations.literal: On guimao tomb visits at Cold Food Festival were to be written into the Five Rites as perpetual statute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Cold Food tomb visits entered the Five Rites as permanent custom.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金仙長公主薨。

translations.literal: On xinhai Princess Jinxian of the Long Line died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Princess Jinxian died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，信安王獻奚、契丹之俘，上御應天門受之。

translations.literal: On wuchen Prince Xin’an presented Xi and Khitan captives; the emperor received them at the Gate of Answering Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Yi presented Khitan and Xi prisoners; the throne took them at Yingtian Gate.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，單于大都護、河北東道行軍元帥、忠王浚加司徒，都護如故；

translations.literal: In the sixth month on dingchou Li Jun, Prince Zhong, Grand Protector of the Shanyu Protectorate and Hebei campaign marshal, was made Grand Mentor while keeping the protectorate;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the sixth month Prince Zhong Li Jun, Shanyu protector and Hebei marshal, became Grand Mentor and kept the protectorate;

sentences.zh: 副大使信安王禕加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: deputy marshal Prince Xin’an Li Yi was made Grand Guardian Equal in Rank.
translations.idiomatic: his deputy Li Yi was made Grand Guardian Equal in Rank.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幽州長史趙含章坐盜用庫物，左監門員外將軍楊元方受含章饋餉，並於朝堂決杖，流瀼州，皆賜死於路。

translations.literal: On gengyin Youzhou chief administrator Zhao Hanzang was punished for embezzling stores; Left Gate Guards vice-general Yang Yuanfang was punished for receiving Hanzang’s gifts; both were beaten at court, exiled to Rang, and executed on the road.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhao Hanzang was flogged and exiled for looting the treasury; Yang Yuanfang for taking his bribes—both died on the road to Rang.

sentences.zh: 其月，遣範安及於長安廣花萼樓，築夾城至芙蓉園。

translations.literal: That month Fan Anji was sent to broaden the Flower-and-Calyx Pavilion in Chang’an and build a covered corridor to the Lotus Park.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fan Anji widened the Flower-and-Calyx Tower and linked it by gallery to the Lotus Park.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，幸寧王憲宅，即日還宮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on wuchen he visited Prince Ning Li Xian’s mansion and returned the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuchen, he visited Prince Ning and returned the same day.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the xinwei new moon of the eighth month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth-month xinwei new moon brought a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，戶部尚書王晙卒。

translations.literal: On jimao Minister of Revenue Wang Jun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Revenue Minister Wang Jun died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，中書令蕭嵩等奏上《開元新禮》一百五十卷，制所司行用之。

translations.literal: On yisi Chancellor Xiao Song and others presented one hundred fifty scrolls of the New Kaiyuan Rites; an edict ordered the offices to put them in use.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Xiao Song submitted 150 scrolls of Kaiyuan New Rites; the throne ordered them used.

sentences.zh: 渤海靺鞨寇登州，殺刺史韋俊，命左領軍將軍蓋福順發兵討之。

translations.literal: Mohe of Bohai raided Dengzhou and killed prefect Wei Jun; Left Valiant Guards general Gai Fushun was ordered to campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Bohai Mohe struck Dengzhou, killed Wei Jun, and Gai Fushun was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，命巡幸所至，有賢才未聞達者舉之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on bingxu, wherever the imperial tour passed, talented men not yet known were to be recommended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the tenth month, on tour he ordered unknown talent recommended.

sentences.zh: 仍令中書門下疏決囚徒。

translations.literal: The Secretariat and Chancellery were also ordered to review and sentence prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat and Chancellery were told to clear the prisons.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，至潞州之飛龍宮，給復三年，兵募丁防先差未發者，令改出餘州。

translations.literal: On xinmao he reached Feilong Palace in Luzhou; tax relief for three years; conscripts and corvée not yet sent were reassigned to other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he reached Luzhou’s Feilong Palace, granted three years’ tax relief, and shifted undrafted levies to other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，至北都。

translations.literal: On xinchou he reached the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he arrived at the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，曲赦太原，給復三年。

translations.literal: On guichou Taiyuan received a partial amnesty and three years’ tax relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Taiyuan was partially amnestied and given three years’ relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，祀后土於脽上，大赦天下，左降官量移近處。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on gengwu he sacrificed to Earth at Fenyin; a great amnesty; demoted officials were moved nearer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he worshipped Earth at Fenyin, amnestied the realm, and moved banished officials closer.

sentences.zh: 內外文武官加一階，開元勛臣盡假紫及緋。

translations.literal: Civil and military officers within and without each gained one rank; Kaiyuan merit nobles were all lent purple and scarlet.
translations.idiomatic: Every officer rose one rank; Kaiyuan merit peers were lent purple and scarlet robes.

sentences.zh: 大酺三日。

translations.literal: Great feasting for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of public feasting were proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，至京師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on renshen he reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen, he entered the capital.

sentences.zh: 其年戶部計戶七百八十六萬一千二百三十六，口四千五百四十三萬一千二百六十五。

translations.literal: That year the Revenue Ministry counted 7,861,236 households and 45,431,265 persons.
translations.idiomatic: The year’s census: 7,861,236 households and 45,431,265 people.

sentences.zh: 開元二十一年二十一年春正月庚子朔，制令士庶家藏《老子》一本，每年貢舉人量減《尚書》、《論語》兩條策，加《老子》策，乙巳，遷祔肅明皇后神主於廟，毀儀坤廟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 21, in spring, the first month, on the gengzi new moon, an edict ordered every household to keep a copy of the Laozi; examination candidates were to lose two Shangshu and Lunyu questions and gain a Laozi question; on yisi the tablet of Empress Zhaoming the Solemn was moved into the temple and the Yikun shrine destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 21 opened with an order that every home keep the Laozi, exams trade two Confucian questions for one on the Laozi, and on yisi Empress Zhaoming’s tablet entered the temple while Yikun was razed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On dingsi he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he went to the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 己未，命工部尚書李嵩使於吐蕃。

translations.literal: On jiwei Minister of Works Li Song was sent as envoy to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Song of Works went to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，至自溫泉宮。

translations.literal: On guihai he returned from the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he came back from the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，侍中裴光庭薨。

translations.literal: On yisi Attendant-in-Chief Pei Guangting died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Pei Guangting, Attendant-in-Chief, died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，尚書右丞韓休為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On jiayin Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Han Xiu became Yellow Gate Vice Director and “equal” in the Secretariat-Chancellery council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Han Xiu joined the council as Yellow Gate Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 閏月，幽州道副總管郭英傑等討契丹，為所敗於都山之下，英傑死之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Youzhou deputy commander Guo Yingjie attacked the Khitan and was defeated below Mount Du; Yingjie died.
translations.idiomatic: In the leap month Guo Yingjie fell to the Khitan at Mount Du.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以久旱，命太子少保陸象先、戶部尚書杜暹等七人往諸道宣慰賑給，及令黜陟官吏，疏決囚徒。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dingsi, because of long drought, the crown prince’s junior tutor Lu Xiangxian, Revenue Minister Du Xian, and seven others were sent to the circuits to comfort, relieve, review officials, and clear prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the fourth month, after drought, Lu Xiangxian, Du Xian, and five others toured the provinces to relieve, audit, and judge prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，寧王憲為太尉，薛王業為司徒，慶王潭為太子太師，忠王浚為開府儀同三司，棣王洽為太子少傅，鄂王涓為太子太保。

translations.literal: On dingyou Prince Ning Li Xian became Grand Commandant; Prince Xue Li Ye became Grand Mentor; Prince Qing Li Tan became Grand Tutor of the Heir; Prince Zhong Li Jun became Grand Guardian Equal in Rank; Prince Di Li Qia became Junior Tutor of the Heir; Prince E Li Juan became Protector of the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Li Xian became Grand Commandant, Li Ye Grand Mentor, Li Tan the heir’s grand tutor, Li Jun Grand Guardian Equal in Rank, Li Qia junior tutor, Li Juan protector.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，皇太子納妃薛氏。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jiashen the crown prince took Lady Xue as consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the heir married Lady Xue.

sentences.zh: 制天下死罪降從流，流已下釋放。

translations.literal: An edict commuted capital crimes to exile and released those below exile.
translations.idiomatic: Capital sentences became exile; lesser offenders were freed.

sentences.zh: 京文武官賜勛一轉。

translations.literal: Capital civil and military officers each received one merit turn.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officers gained one merit notch.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the yichou new moon of the seventh month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh-month yichou new moon brought a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，封皇子溢為濟王，沔為信王，泚為義王，漼為陳王，澄為豐王，潓為恆王，漩為涼王，滔為深王。

translations.literal: On renyang princes were enfeoffed: Yi as Prince of Ji, Min as Prince of Xin, Ci as Prince of Yi, Cui as Prince of Chen, Cheng as Prince of Feng, Hui as Prince of Heng, Xuan as Prince of Liang, Tao as Prince of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang eight princes were enfeoffed—Ji, Xin, Yi, Chen, Feng, Heng, Liang, and Shen among them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，幸溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on gengxu he visited the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the tenth month he went to the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，尚書右丞相宋璟以年老請致仕，許之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on wuzi Right Chancellor Song Jing asked to retire on account of age; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Song Jing retired for age.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，兵部尚書、徐國公蕭嵩為尚書右丞相，黃門侍郎韓休為兵部尚書，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on dingwei Xiao Song, Minister of War and Duke of Xu, became Right Chancellor; Han Xiu became Minister of War; both left the council.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xiao Song became Right Chancellor and Han Xiu War Minister; both left the council.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹裴耀卿為黃門侍郎，前中書侍郎張九齡起復舊官，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Jingzhao Intendant Pei Yaoqing became Yellow Gate Vice Director; former Vice Director of the Secretariat Zhang Jiuling was restored; both joined the council.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Yaoqing and Zhang Jiuling rejoined the council as equals under the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 是歲，關中久雨害稼，京師饑，詔出太倉米二百萬石給之。

translations.literal: That year long rains in Guanzhong ruined the crops; the capital hungered; an edict released two million bushels from the great granary.
translations.idiomatic: Rains wrecked Guanzhong’s harvest; famine hit the capital; two million bushels left the granary.

sentences.zh: 開元二十二年二十二年春正月癸亥朔，制古聖帝明皇、嶽瀆海鎮用牲牢，餘並以酒酺充奠。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 22, in spring, the first month, on the guihai new moon, an edict: ancient sage emperors, the Bright Emperor, and the sacred mountains, rivers, and seas were to use livestock; all else was to use wine libations only.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 22 began with wine-only offerings save for sage kings, the Bright Emperor, and the great mountains and seas.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸東都。

translations.literal: On jisi he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he traveled east.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太府卿嚴挺之、戶部侍郎裴寬於河南存問賑給。

translations.literal: On xinwei Grand Treasury Director Yan Tingzhi and Vice Minister of Revenue Pei Kuan were sent to Henan to comfort and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yan Tingzhi and Pei Kuan relieved Henan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，懷、衛、邢、相等五州乏糧，遣中書舍人裴敦復巡問，量給種子。

translations.literal: On yiyou five prefectures—Huai, Wei, Xing, Xiang, and others—lacked grain; Vice Director of the Secretariat Pei Dunfu was sent to inspect and issue seed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou five prefectures needed seed; Pei Dunfu was sent to assess and supply.

sentences.zh: 己丑，至東都。

translations.literal: On jichou he reached the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he arrived at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，秦州地震，廨宇及居人廬舍崩壞殆盡，壓死官吏已下四十餘人，殷殷有聲，仍連震不止。

translations.literal: On renyin Qinzhou was shaken by earthquake; government halls and dwellings were nearly all destroyed; more than forty officials and others were crushed; rumbling continued without cease.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Qinzhou quaked; halls and homes collapsed; forty-odd were killed; the ground thundered on and on.

sentences.zh: 命尚書右丞相蕭嵩往祭山川，並遣使存問賑恤之，壓死之家給復一年，一家三人已上死者給復二年。

translations.literal: Right Chancellor Xiao Song was ordered to sacrifice to mountains and rivers and send envoys to comfort; households of the crushed received one year’s tax relief, or two if three or more in one family died.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Song sacrificed and sent relief; crushed families got one year’s remission, two if three died in one house.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，初置十道採訪處置使。

translations.literal: On xinhai the ten-circuit Investigation and Disposition commissioners were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the ten-circuit investigation commissioners were created.

sentences.zh: 徵恆州張果先生，授銀青光祿大夫，號曰通玄先生三月，沒京兆商人任令方資財六十餘萬貫。

translations.literal: Zhang Guo of Hengzhou was summoned, given Silver Glory Grand Master for Palace Attendance, and styled Master Tongxuan; in the third month the assets of Chang’an merchant Ren Lingfang, more than six hundred thousand strings, were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guo the immortal was summoned and styled Master Tongxuan; in the third month Ren Lingfang’s six hundred thousand strings were seized.

sentences.zh: 壬午，欲令不禁私鑄錢，遣公卿百僚詳議可否。

translations.literal: On renwu he wished to lift the ban on private coinage and sent the high ministers and hundred officials to debate whether it was feasible.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he proposed legalizing private minting and ordered a full court debate.

sentences.zh: 眾以為不可，遂止。

translations.literal: The multitude deemed it impossible, and the matter stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The court said no; the plan died.

sentences.zh: 四月乙未，伊西、北庭且依舊為節度。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on yiwei Yixi and Beiting remained frontier commands as before.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Yixi and Beiting stayed frontier commands.

sentences.zh: 廢太廟署，以太常寺奉宗廟。

translations.literal: The Directorate of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was abolished; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices tended the shrines.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple office was folded into the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 庚子，唐州界準勝州例立表，測候日晷影長短。

translations.literal: On gengzi in Tang prefecture a gnomon was set up on the Shengzhou model to measure the sundial shadow’s length.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Tang set a shadow-measuring pole like Shengzhou’s.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔京都見禁囚徒，令中書門下及留守檢覆降罪，天下諸州委刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict on prisoners held in the capital: the Secretariat-Chancellery and the stay-behind were to review and reduce sentences; in the provinces, prefects were responsible.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi capital prisoners went to the council and stay-behind for review; elsewhere, to prefects.

sentences.zh: 丁未，眉州鼎皇山下江水中得寶鼎。

translations.literal: On dingwei a precious tripod was found in the river below Dinghuang Mountain in Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Meizhou fishermen found a sacred tripod in the river.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，北庭都護劉渙謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiayin Protector-General of Beiting Liu Huan plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Liu Huan of Beiting rebelled and was killed.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，黃門侍郎裴耀卿為侍中，中書侍郎張九齡為中書令，黃門侍郎李林甫為禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on wuzi Pei Yaoqing became Attendant-in-Chief; Zhang Jiuling became Chancellor of the Secretariat; Li Linfu became Minister of Rites and council equal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Pei Yaoqing became chief attendant, Zhang Jiuling chancellor, Li Linfu joined the council as Rites Minister.

sentences.zh: 關中大風拔木，同州尤甚。

translations.literal: In Guanzhong a great wind uprooted trees; Tongzhou suffered worst.
translations.idiomatic: Guanzhong’s gale uprooted trees; Tongzhou was hit hardest.

sentences.zh: 是夏，上自於苑中種麥，率皇太子已下躬自收獲，謂太子等曰：「此將薦宗廟，是以躬親，亦欲令汝等知稼穡之難也。

translations.literal: That summer the emperor himself planted wheat in the park, leading the crown prince and those below to harvest in person, saying to the crown prince and others, “This will be offered to the ancestral temple; therefore I labor with my own hands, and also wish to make you know the difficulty of sowing and reaping.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he planted wheat in the park and made the heir and younger princes reap with him, telling them, “This grain is for the ancestors—I work so you may feel how hard the fields are.”

sentences.zh: 」因分賜侍臣，謂曰：「比歲令人巡檢苗稼，所對多不實，故自種植以觀其成；

translations.literal: ” He then distributed shares to the attendant ministers, saying, “In recent years when men were sent to inspect the crops, their reports were often untrue; therefore I plant myself to watch them ripen;
translations.idiomatic: Then he gave portions to his courtiers and said, “Year after year the crop inspectors lied; I planted myself to see the truth.”

sentences.zh: 且《春秋》書麥禾，豈非古人所重也！

translations.literal: Moreover, does not the Spring and Autumn record wheat and grain—was that not what the ancients prized!
translations.idiomatic: Did not the Spring and Autumn prize wheat and grain? The ancients weighed them heavily.

sentences.zh: 」六月乙未，遣左金吾將軍李佺於赤嶺與吐蕃分界立碑。

translations.literal: ” In the sixth month on yiwei he sent Left Golden Guards General Li Quan to Red Ridge to erect boundary markers with Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: With that he ended; on sixth-month yiwei he sent Li Quan to mark the border with Tibet at Red Ridge.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，司徒、薛王業薨，追謚為惠宣太子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on jisi Grand Mentor, Prince Xue Li Ye, died and was posthumously styled Crown Prince Hui and Solemn.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Prince Xue Li Ye died and was mourned as Crown Prince Hui and Solemn.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣中書令張九齡充河南開稻田使。

translations.literal: On jiashen he sent Chancellor Zhang Jiuling as Henan Commissioner for Opening Paddy Fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhang Jiuling became Henan paddy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月，先是駕至東都，遣侍中裴耀卿充江淮、河南轉運使，河口置輸場。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, earlier when the imperial carriage had reached the Eastern Capital, Attendant-in-Chief Pei Yaoqing had been made commissioner for Jiang-Huai and Henan transport, with a transshipment depot at the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month: when the court had moved east, Pei Yaoqing became Jiang-Huai and Henan transport commissioner and built a depot at the river mouth.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，於輸場東置河陰縣。

translations.literal: On renyin Heyin County was established east of the transshipment depot.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Heyin county was founded east of the depot.

sentences.zh: 又遣張九齡於許、豫、陳、亳等州置水屯。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiuling was also sent to establish water colonies in Xu, Yu, Chen, Bo, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiuling also opened water farms in Xu, Yu, Chen, Bo, and the like.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，改饒樂都督府為奉誠都督府。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renshen Raole Protectorate was renamed Fengcheng Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Raole became Fengcheng Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，移登州平海軍於海口安置。

translations.literal: On xinsi the Pinghai Army of Dengzhou was moved to a post at the seaport.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Dengzhou’s Pinghai Army shifted to the harbor mouth.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，試司農卿陳思問以贓私配流瀼州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jiachen Acting Minister of Agriculture Chen Siwen was exiled to Rang for graft.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Chen Siwen, acting agriculture minister, was exiled for corruption.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the wuzi new moon of the twelfth month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth-month wuzi new moon brought a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幽州長史張守珪發兵討契丹，斬其王屈烈及其大臣可突幹於陣，傳首東都，餘叛奚皆散走山谷。

translations.literal: On yisi Youzhou chief administrator Zhang Shougui led troops against the Khitan, beheading their king Qulie and the minister Ketugan in battle; heads were sent to the Eastern Capital; the rebel Xi scattered into the hills.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Zhang Shougui slew Khitan king Qulie and Ketugan in battle and sent their heads east; rebel Xi fled the valleys.

sentences.zh: 立其酋長李過折為契丹王。

translations.literal: Their chieftain Li Guozhe was installed as king of the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guozhe was made Khitan king.

sentences.zh: 是歲，突厥毗伽可汗死。

translations.literal: That year the Türk qaghan Bilge died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Türk qaghan Bilge died.

sentences.zh: 斷京城乞兒。

translations.literal: Begging in the capital was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Capital begging was banned.

sentences.zh: 開元二十三年二十三年春正月己亥，親耕籍田，上加至九推而止，卿已下終其畝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 23, in spring, on the jihai day, he personally plowed the sacred field; the emperor added up to nine furrows and stopped; ministers and below finished the acre.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 23’s spring plowing saw the emperor push nine furrows, then ministers finish the field.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 京文武官及朝集採訪使三品已下加一爵，四品已下加一階，外官賜勛一轉。

translations.literal: Capital civil and military officers and investigation commissioners of third rank and below each gained one noble rank; fourth rank and below gained one office rank; outer officials one merit turn.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officers to third rank rose a noble grade; to fourth rank an office step; outer officers a merit turn.

sentences.zh: 其才有霸王之略、學究天人之際、及堪將帥牧宰者，令五品已上清官及刺史各舉一人。

translations.literal: Those with hegemonic strategy, learning that plumbs heaven and man, or talent for command and magistracy were to be nominated one each by fifth-rank pure officials and prefects.
translations.idiomatic: Men of grand strategy, cosmic learning, or command were to be nominated by fifth-rank officers and prefects.

sentences.zh: 致仕官量與改職，依前致仕。

translations.literal: Retired officers were given posts as suited, as in former retirements.
translations.idiomatic: Retirees were reappointed where fitting, as before.

sentences.zh: 賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Feasting was granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of feasting were proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，殿中侍御史楊萬頃為仇人所殺。

translations.literal: In the third month on dingmao Palace Attending Censor Yang Wanqing was killed by a personal enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Palace Censor Yang Wanqing was murdered by a foe.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，宗子請率月俸於興慶宮建龍池，上《聖德頌》。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on wuyin, imperial clansmen asked to pool monthly stipends to build the Dragon Pool at Xingqing Palace and presented a “Ode to Sagely Virtue.”
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the fifth month clansmen pooled stipends for Xingqing’s Dragon Pool and offered an ode to sagely virtue.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，皇太子鴻改名瑛，慶王直已下十四王並改名。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on bingzi the crown prince Hong was renamed Ying; fourteen princes from Prince Qing Zhi downward were also renamed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the heir Hong became Ying and fourteen younger princes took new names.

sentences.zh: 又封皇子玭為義王，珪為陳王，珙為豐王，琪為恆王，璿為涼王，璥為汴王。

translations.literal: Princes were further enfeoffed: Min as Prince of Yi, Gui as Prince of Chen, Gong as Prince of Feng, Qi as Prince of Heng, Xuan as Prince of Liang, Jin as Prince of Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Six more princes were enfeoffed—Yi, Chen, Feng, Heng, Liang, and Bian among them.

sentences.zh: 其榮王琬已下並開府置官屬，各食實封二千戶。

translations.literal: Princes from Rong Wang Wan downward each opened a mansion with staff and received two thousand households in substantive fief.
translations.idiomatic: From Prince Rong Wan down, each opened a household staff and drew a two-thousand-household fief.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，制鰥寡惸獨免今年地稅之半，江淮已南有遭水處，本道使賑給之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on wuzi an edict: widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless were exempted from half this year’s land tax; south of the Yangtze where flood had struck, circuit commissioners were to relieve.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the lonely and childless paid half the land tax; flooded south-Yangtze circuits were told to relieve.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，移泗州就臨淮縣置。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on wushen Sizhou was moved to seat at Linhuai County.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Sizhou’s seat shifted to Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，移隸伊西、北庭都護屬四鎮節度。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on xinhai Yixi and Beiting protectors were placed under the Four Garrisons command.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Yixi and Beiting passed to the Four Garrisons command.

sentences.zh: 突騎施寇北庭及安西撥換城。

translations.literal: Turgesh raided Beiting and the Anxi protectorate’s Boluo city.
translations.idiomatic: Turgesh struck Beiting and Anxi’s Boluo.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the renshen new moon of the eleventh month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh-month renshen new moon brought a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十二月，新羅遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Silla sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Silla presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 開元二十四年二十四年春正月，吐蕃遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyuan 24, in spring, the first month, Tibet sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 24 opened with Tibetan tribute.

sentences.zh: 北庭都護蓋嘉運率兵擊突騎施，破之。

translations.literal: Protector-General of Beiting Gai Jiayun led troops against Turgesh and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Jiayun of Beiting broke Turgesh.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，始移考功貢舉遣禮部侍郎掌之。

translations.literal: In the third month on yiwei examination graduates were first transferred from the Directorate of Personnel Evaluation to the Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei civil graduates passed from Personnel Evaluation to the Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丙午，京兆醴泉妖人劉志誠率眾為亂，將趨京城，咸陽官吏燒便橋以斷其路，俄而散走，京兆府盡擒斬之。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, on bingwu, sorcerer Liu Zhicheng of Liquan in Jingzhao led a mob in revolt and marched on the capital; Xianyang officials burned Bian Bridge to cut them off; soon they scattered; the metropolitan prefecture captured and beheaded them all.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Liu Zhicheng of Liquan rose toward the capital; Xianyang burned Bian Bridge; the rebels scattered and Jingzhao executed them all.

sentences.zh: 是夏大熱，道路有暍死者。

translations.literal: That summer was fiercely hot; on the roads men died of heatstroke.
translations.idiomatic: The summer scorched; travelers dropped dead of heat.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，太子太保陸象先卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on gengzi Grand Protector of the Heir Lu Xiangxian died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the heir’s protector Lu Xiangxian died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李林甫為兵部尚書，依舊知政事。

translations.literal: On xinchou Li Linfu became Minister of War and still managed state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Linfu took War and kept the council.

sentences.zh: 己巳，初置壽星壇，祭老人星及角、亢等七宿。

translations.literal: On jisi the Longevity Star Altar was first established, sacrificing to the Old Man Star and the seven lodges Jiao, Kang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Longevity Star altar was founded for the Old Man and seven lodges including Jiao and Kang.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申朔，加親舅小功服，舅母緦麻服，堂舅袒免。

translations.literal: On the wushen new moon of the eighth month mourning for a mother’s brother was raised to xiaogong, for a mother’s brother’s wife to zimam, and for a father’s younger brother’s son to tanmian.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth-month wushen new moon deepened mourning for uncles by blood and marriage.

sentences.zh: 己亥，深王滔薨九月壬午，改尚書主爵曰司封。

translations.literal: On jihai Prince Shen of the Deep, Tao, died; in the ninth month on renwu the Directorate of Titles was renamed Directorate of Enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Prince Shen Tao died; in the ninth month the Titles office became Enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，車駕發東都，還西京。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on wushen the imperial carriage left the Eastern Capital and returned to the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the court quit the Eastern Capital for the west.

sentences.zh: 甲子，至華州，曲赦行在系囚。

translations.literal: On jiazi he reached Huazhou and granted a partial amnesty to prisoners at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: At Huazhou on jiazi he amnestied prisoners on tour.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，至自東都。

translations.literal: On dingchou he returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he came back from the east.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，侍中裴耀卿為尚書左丞相，中書令張九齡為尚書右丞相，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on renyin Attendant-in-Chief Pei Yaoqing became Left Chancellor; Chancellor Zhang Jiuling became Right Chancellor; both left the council.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Pei Yaoqing became Left Chancellor and Zhang Jiuling Right; both left the council.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書李林甫兼中書令，殿中監牛仙客兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: War Minister Li Linfu also became Chancellor of the Secretariat; Palace Director Niu Xianke became War Minister and third-rank council equal.
translations.idiomatic: Li Linfu doubled as chancellor; Niu Xianke joined the council as War Minister.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞相蕭嵩為太子太師，工部尚書韓休為太子少保。

translations.literal: Right Chancellor Xiao Song became Grand Tutor of the Heir; Works Minister Han Xiu became Junior Tutor of the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Song tutored the heir; Han Xiu became junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，太子太師、慶王琮為司徒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on wushen Grand Tutor of the Heir, Prince Qing Zong, became Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Prince Qing Zong became Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，牛仙客知門下省事。

translations.literal: On bingyin Niu Xianke managed Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Niu Xianke took charge of the Chancellery.
